stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Maria Hill approves May's transfer to a desk job after the mission in Bahrain, and May works in Hill's field office until Coulson recruits her. After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, May confronts Hill to find out who ran Project T.A.H.I.T.I., the program that brought Coulson back.
stages.whoA: An agent in her field office, who later confronts her about T.A.H.I.T.I.
stages.whoB: Her boss after Bahrain. Later May demands answers from her about T.A.H.I.T.I.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill and Natasha Romanoff serve together at S.H.I.E.L.D. under Nick Fury.
stages.whoA: A fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agent under Nick Fury.
stages.whoB: A fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agent under Nick Fury.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Hydra surfaces inside S.H.I.E.L.D., Hill rescues Natasha, Steve and Sam from custody and fights beside them to stop Project Insight.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent. Hill rescues her from custody to stop Project Insight.
stages.whoB: A fellow agent who rescues her from custody and helps stop Project Insight.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill is Nick Fury's right hand at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his most trusted friends.
stages.whoA: Her boss and one of her most trusted friends at S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: His right hand at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his most trusted friends.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Hill joins Fury when he comes back to Earth to stop the rogue Skrulls. In Moscow she is shot dead by Gravik, who is wearing Fury's face.
stages.whoA: Her old boss and friend. She joins his fight against the Skrulls and dies.
stages.whoB: His right hand. Gravik shoots her dead in Moscow while wearing his face.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill and Phil Coulson serve together as Nick Fury's trusted lieutenants at S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: A fellow lieutenant of Nick Fury's at S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: A fellow lieutenant of Nick Fury's at S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Hill leads the Air Force to Coulson's hideout at Providence, hoping a deal will keep his team out of prison. When the soldiers take the team captive, she fights them off and helps Coulson's people escape.
stages.whoA: An old colleague. She seeks a deal for his team, then frees them.
stages.whoB: An old colleague who brings the Air Force, then helps his team escape.

stages.text: On Nick Fury's orders, Soren takes Maria Hill's form and fills in for her during the Elemental crisis in Europe, working beside Spider-Man and Mysterio.
stages.whoA: A Skrull who takes her form on Fury's orders during the Elemental crisis.
stages.whoB: The agent whose form she takes for Fury during the Elemental crisis.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Maria Hill helps Steve Rogers take down the Project Insight helicarriers when Hydra is exposed inside S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Captain America. She helps him take down the Insight helicarriers.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who helps him take down the Insight helicarriers.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Hill now runs operations for the Avengers while Steve leads the team in the field.
stages.whoA: The Avengers' field leader, while she runs their operations.
stages.whoB: The Avengers' operations chief, while he leads them in the field.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Maria Hill goes to work for Tony Stark and runs operations for the Avengers out of his tower. She coordinates the team from the raid on Strucker's base to the Battle of Sokovia.
stages.whoA: Her boss. She runs Avengers operations out of his tower.
stages.whoB: His operations chief for the Avengers, working out of his tower.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva tries to shoot Maria Rambeau down in a dogfight over Earth, but Maria shoots her down instead.
stages.whoA: A Kree sniper who tries to shoot her down in a dogfight, and loses.
stages.whoB: The pilot who shoots her down in a dogfight over Earth.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Monica Rambeau is Maria Rambeau's daughter, a bright young girl who idolizes her mother's best friend Carol Danvers.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, a bright girl who idolizes Carol Danvers.
stages.whoB: Her mother, a pilot and Carol Danvers' best friend.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Maria dies of cancer while Monica is gone in the Blip, and Monica comes back to find her mother lost.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, who is gone in the Blip when Maria dies of cancer.
stages.whoB: Her mother, who dies of cancer while Monica is gone in the Blip.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Nick Fury comes to Maria Rambeau's home with Carol Danvers and joins the fight against the Kree.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who comes to her home with Carol and fights the Kree.
stages.whoB: Carol's best friend. He comes to her home and joins her against the Kree.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Maria Rambeau flies with Carol Danvers to Mar-Vell's hidden lab in orbit, where they find Soren, her daughter G'iah and other Skrull refugees. Maria helps get the Skrulls to safety from the Kree.
stages.whoA: A Skrull refugee she helps get to safety from the Kree.
stages.whoB: A pilot who helps get her and her daughter safe from the Kree.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Talos first comes to Earth hunting Carol Danvers, and Maria Rambeau treats him as an enemy. Once he turns out to be a refugee, Maria flies the mission to save his people.
stages.whoA: A Skrull she first takes for an enemy, then flies to save.
stages.whoB: Carol's best friend, who flies the mission to save his people.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward is a senior S.W.O.R.D. officer under its founding director, Maria Rambeau. After her death he takes over as acting director.
stages.whoA: A senior S.W.O.R.D. officer who takes over as director after she dies.
stages.whoB: His director at S.W.O.R.D. He takes her place after she dies.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Morgan Stark is Maria Stark's granddaughter, born to her son Tony and Pepper Potts long after Maria's death.
stages.whoA: Her granddaughter, Tony's daughter, born long after Maria's death.
stages.whoB: Her grandmother, Tony's mother, who died long before she was born.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Maria Stark is Tony Stark's mother. Learning that the Winter Soldier murdered her tears Tony and Steve Rogers apart.
stages.whoA: Her son, torn from Steve Rogers when he learns how she died.
stages.whoB: His mother. Learning the Winter Soldier murdered her tears him from Steve.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty works to bring Mariah Dillard to justice for Cottonmouth's death, but Mariah escapes charges by having the only witness, Candace Miller, killed.
stages.whoA: A detective who wants her charged for Cottonmouth's death.
stages.whoB: A councilwoman who dodges Cottonmouth's murder by having the witness killed.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty keeps chasing Mariah as she wages a bloody war with Bushmaster, and she finally gets the evidence to take her down when Shades turns on her.
stages.whoA: The detective who keeps chasing her and finally gets the evidence.
stages.whoB: Harlem's crime boss. Shades' betrayal finally gives Misty the evidence to take her down.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah Dillard and Priscilla Ridley were sorority sisters, and Ridley, now head of the Harlem precinct, comforts Mariah after Cottonmouth's murder.
stages.whoA: Her old sorority sister, now head of the Harlem precinct.
stages.whoB: Her old sorority sister, whom she comforts after Cottonmouth's murder.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Ridley works to bring Mariah down, and after Tom Ridenhour's murder she arrests Mariah herself.
stages.whoA: Her old sorority sister, who arrests her after Ridenhour's murder.
stages.whoB: Her old sorority sister, whom she arrests after Ridenhour's murder.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah Dillard calls Rosalie Carbone and the other crime bosses to a meeting to work together. Rosalie later turns against her.
stages.whoA: A crime boss she calls in to work together, who later turns on her.
stages.whoB: A Harlem crime boss who invites her to work together, until Rosalie turns.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades helps Mariah Dillard cover up her murder of Cottonmouth, and the two become lovers and partners in crime.
stages.whoA: Her lover and partner in crime, who helps cover up her murder of Cottonmouth.
stages.whoB: His lover and partner in crime. He helps her cover up Cottonmouth's murder.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades loses faith in Mariah as her war with Bushmaster turns savage. He betrays her and turns witness against her.
stages.whoA: Her former lover, who betrays her and turns witness against her.
stages.whoB: His former lover, whose savage war with Bushmaster makes him turn on her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah Dillard is Tilda Johnson's mother, and she gave her up as a child. Tilda poisons Mariah in prison.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, given up as a child, who poisons her in prison.
stages.whoB: Her mother, who gave her up as a child. Tilda poisons her in prison.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Police captain Tom Ridenhour, who dated Mariah Dillard in high school, works to bring down her crime family. He questions her, offers her a deal, and is murdered while meeting the informant he hired to spy on her.
stages.whoA: Her high school boyfriend, now a police captain trying to bring her down.
stages.whoB: His high school girlfriend, now the crime boss he is trying to take down.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Marion James and Rafael Hernandez are old friends, and he sees her as one of the good agents at the CIA. Together they help Madani bring down William Rawlins and offer Frank Castle his freedom in return.
stages.whoA: An old friend. Together they help Madani take down William Rawlins.
stages.whoB: An old friend, and to him one of the CIA's good agents.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: William Rawlins works under Marion James at the CIA, and she ends up helping bring him down.
stages.whoA: Her subordinate at the CIA, whom she helps bring down.
stages.whoB: His superior at the CIA, who helps bring him down.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Martha Williams is Simon's mother, and she raises him and his older brother Eric on her own after their father dies when Simon is still a young boy.
stages.whoA: Her younger son, whom she raises alone after his father dies.
stages.whoB: His mother, who raises him and Eric alone after their father dies.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Martinex is Stakar Ogord's first mate and longtime teammate in the Ravagers. He stays at Stakar's side after their old team breaks up, and they bring the crew back together after Yondu's death.
stages.whoA: His captain. As first mate, Martinex helps him reunite the old crew.
stages.whoB: His first mate and longtime teammate in the Ravagers.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Martinex served with Yondu on Stakar Ogord's old crew. When Stakar shuns the exiled Yondu on Contraxia, Martinex shares a silent look with his old teammate before following Stakar out.
stages.whoA: An old teammate, now exiled, with whom he shares a silent look.
stages.whoB: An old teammate who shares a silent look with him on Contraxia.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty clashes with Mary Walker, the unstable mercenary known as Typhoid Mary.
stages.whoA: A detective she clashes with.
stages.whoB: Typhoid Mary, an unstable mercenary she clashes with.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mary Walker and Ward Meachum go to Turk Barrett for weapons to kill Davos, and Turk sells Mary an M4 rifle with armor-piercing rounds. She knows her guns well enough to correct him on the exact model.
stages.whoA: An arms dealer who sells her an M4 to kill Davos.
stages.whoB: A mercenary who buys an M4 from him and corrects him on its model.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mary Walker digs up information on Ward Meachum and later goes with him to buy weapons.
stages.whoA: A target she digs up dirt on, then goes to buy weapons with.
stages.whoB: A mercenary who digs into him, then goes with him to buy weapons.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter Quill bluffs his way past Master Karja by posing as a worker, and Karja ends up venting to him about his annoying subordinate. When Karja's guards later corner the Guardians, Peter hacks their suits and sends Karja flying out of control.
stages.whoA: A Guardian posing as a worker, who hacks his suit and sends him flying.
stages.whoB: An Orgosentry boss he bluffs past, then sends flying by hacking his suit.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Master Karja leads the Orgosentries who guard the High Evolutionary's Orgoscope. When the Guardians break in to steal Rocket's file, Karja and his guards hunt them through the station on his master's orders.
stages.whoA: His master, whose Orgoscope he guards.
stages.whoB: The leader of his Orgosentries, who hunts the Guardians on his orders.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: As Daredevil, Matt Murdock fights Maya Lopez while she is working as one of Wilson Fisk's enforcers.
stages.whoA: One of Wilson Fisk's enforcers, whom he fights as Daredevil.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, whom she fights while working as Fisk's enforcer.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Melvin Potter is a gifted craftsman forced to work for Fisk. Matt protects him, and Melvin builds Daredevil's armored suit.
stages.whoA: A gifted craftsman he protects, who builds his armored suit.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, who protects him. Melvin builds his armored suit.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Detective Misty Knight works alongside Matt and the other Defenders during the fight against the Hand.
stages.whoA: A detective who fights the Hand alongside the Defenders.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, one of the Defenders she works with against the Hand.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is a CIA agent working with Fisk on an illegal weapons deal, which Matt and Jessica Jones blow up.
stages.whoA: A CIA agent whose weapons deal with Fisk he blows up.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, who blows up his illegal weapons deal with Fisk.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Murakami is one of the Hand's leaders, whom Matt and the Defenders fight beneath Midland Circle.
stages.whoA: One of the Hand's leaders, whom he fights beneath Midland Circle.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, one of the Defenders who fight the Hand at Midland Circle.

stages.text: Daredevil fights the serial killer Muse to rescue Angela del Toro from his lair.
stages.whoA: A serial killer he fights to rescue Angela del Toro.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, who fights him to rescue Angela del Toro from his lair.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Nobu, a leader of the Hand, nearly kills Matt in their first fight, and Matt barely survives by setting him on fire.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader who nearly kills him, until Matt sets him on fire.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, who survives their first fight by setting him on fire.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nobu returns alive, and Matt faces him again in the war with the Hand over Elektra.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader who returns alive to fight him over Elektra.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, whom he faces again in the Hand's war over Elektra.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Matt Murdock is Peter Parker's lawyer after Peter's identity is exposed, and he gets the charges against him dropped.
stages.whoA: A client whose charges he gets dropped after his identity is exposed.
stages.whoB: His lawyer, who gets his charges dropped after his identity is exposed.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: FBI agent Ray Nadeem first guards Fisk and hunts Daredevil. He later turns on Fisk and helps Matt, until Bullseye kills him.
stages.whoA: An FBI agent who turns on Fisk to help him, until Bullseye kills him.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, whom he first hunts and later helps after turning on Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Matt Murdock questions Ray Schoonover at Frank Castle's trial. Schoonover's sniper attack later nearly kills him and his friends.
stages.whoA: A witness he questions at Castle's trial, whose sniper nearly kills him.
stages.whoB: A lawyer who questions him at Frank Castle's trial.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: District Attorney Samantha Reyes prosecutes Frank Castle against Matt and Foggy while hiding her own role in his family's deaths.
stages.whoA: The DA prosecuting Frank Castle against him, hiding her own guilt.
stages.whoB: Frank Castle's defense lawyer, facing her in court.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Soledad Ayala is Hector's widow. Matt defends her husband in court and searches for her niece Angela when she goes missing.
stages.whoA: Hector's widow. He defends her husband and searches for her niece.
stages.whoB: Her husband's lawyer, who searches for her missing niece Angela.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Stick is the blind warrior who trains young Matt after the accident, and he returns years later to pull Matt into his war with the Hand.
stages.whoA: His mentor, the blind warrior who trains him after the accident.
stages.whoB: His student, whom he trains as a boy and later pulls into his war.

stages.text: Theo Nelson is Foggy's brother and an old friend of Matt's from Hell's Kitchen.
stages.whoA: Foggy's brother and an old friend from Hell's Kitchen.
stages.whoB: An old friend and his brother Foggy's best friend.

stages.text: Turk Barrett is a small-time arms dealer whom Daredevil roughs up for information again and again.
stages.whoA: A small-time arms dealer he roughs up for information again and again.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, who roughs him up for information again and again.

stages.text: Vanessa Fisk is Wilson Fisk's wife. Matt learns she hired Bullseye to kill Foggy and confronts her at the Black and White Ball.
stages.whoA: Fisk's wife, who hired Bullseye to kill Foggy.
stages.whoB: Foggy's best friend, who learns she ordered his death and confronts her.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Vladimir Ranskahov blames Matt Murdock for his brother's death and tortures him. Later they are both trapped in a warehouse by the police, and Vladimir helps Matt escape.
stages.whoA: A Russian gangster who tortures him, then helps him escape the police.
stages.whoB: The man he blames for his brother's death, who he later helps escape.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin, is Matt's greatest enemy, and they fight for control of Hell's Kitchen until Matt helps put him behind bars.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, his greatest enemy, whom he helps put behind bars.
stages.whoB: His greatest enemy, who fights him for Hell's Kitchen and helps jail him.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk gets out of prison as an FBI informant and frames Daredevil with an impostor. Matt beats him but spares his life, and Fisk agrees to leave Matt and his friends alone to keep Vanessa free.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, out of prison and framing him. Matt beats him but spares him.
stages.whoB: His enemy, who beats and spares him, forcing a truce to keep Vanessa free.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Years later Fisk becomes mayor of New York and declares war on vigilantes, and Matt takes up the fight against him for the whole city.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, now mayor of New York and at war with vigilantes.
stages.whoB: His old enemy, who fights his war on vigilantes for the whole city.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Yusuf Khan is trapped in a bank robbery at New York Mutual Bank alongside Matt Murdock. Matt protects him and the two become friends.
stages.whoA: A friend he makes while protecting him in a bank robbery.
stages.whoB: A friend who protects him when they are trapped in a bank robbery.

stages.text: May Parker is Peter Parker's aunt, who raises him in Queens.
stages.whoA: Her nephew, whom she raises in Queens.
stages.whoB: His aunt, who raises him in Queens.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May dies helping Peter cure the villains from other worlds, and her last words teach him that with great power comes great responsibility.
stages.whoA: Her nephew. She dies helping him cure the villains from other worlds.
stages.whoB: His aunt, whose last words teach him great power brings great responsibility.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Maya Hansen comes to warn Tony Stark, and Pepper Potts drags her to safety when the Mandarin's helicopters destroy Tony's home. Maya then reveals she is still working with Aldrich Killian, who takes Pepper captive.
stages.whoA: Tony's partner, who drags her to safety before Killian takes her captive.
stages.whoB: A scientist she saves from the attack, who turns out to work with Killian.

stages.text: Maya Hansen is a scientist who meets Tony Stark in Bern in 1999, where he leaves her an equation to help perfect Extremis after they spend the night together. Years later she comes to him for help with Extremis.
stages.whoA: A one-night stand in 1999 who left her the Extremis equation.
stages.whoB: A scientist he spent a night with in 1999, who seeks his help.

stages.text: Skully, an old friend of Maya's family who runs a pawn shop in Tamaha, welcomes her home and builds her a new prosthetic leg. He also tells her about Chafa, the first Choctaw, from whom her family's power descends.
stages.whoA: An old family friend who builds her a new prosthetic leg.
stages.whoB: A family friend home in Tamaha, for whom he builds a prosthetic leg.

stages.whoA: Her mother, who dies in a car crash when she is a child.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, a child when Taloa dies in a car crash.

stages.text: Tuklo is one of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.
stages.whoA: One of her Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.

stages.text: Wilson Fisk raises Maya Lopez as a surrogate uncle and employs her in his crime empire. When she learns he had her father killed, she shoots him.

stages.text: Fisk survives and comes to Oklahoma to win Maya back, but she uses her family's power to break his hold on her for good.

stages.whoB: His former surrogate niece, who breaks his hold on her in Oklahoma.

stages.whoA: Her boss, whose schemes make her uneasy.
stages.whoB: Her assistant, who quietly tips off Bucky Barnes against her.

stages.whoB: Her surrogate mother from Ohio, who helps her bring down the Red Room.

stages.text: Melina seems to betray her family by calling Taskmaster to her farm to capture them for the Red Room. It is a ruse, and once inside she frees Alexei and locks Taskmaster in a cell.
stages.whoA: The Red Room's enforcer, whom she tricks and locks in a cell.
stages.whoB: A Widow who lures her to the farm, then locks her in a cell.

stages.text: Melina Vostokoff raises Yelena as her daughter during the undercover mission in Ohio. Yelena resents her for helping build the Red Room's mind control, but Melina sides with her daughters in the end and helps free the Widows.

stages.whoB: An agent on the team who keeps her distance at first.

stages.whoB: His agent, who builds Coulson's team and secretly reports on him.

stages.text: As Coulson's life runs out, their feelings for each other finally come out, and May stays with him in Tahiti for his last days.

stages.whoB: The woman he loves, who stays with him in Tahiti for his last days.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: May trains Piper in hand-to-hand combat and leads the strike team she serves on under Director Jeffrey Mace. Piper stays a loyal friend through the years that follow.
stages.whoA: An agent she trains in combat and leads on the strike team.
stages.whoB: Her trainer and strike team leader under Director Mace.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Melinda May hunts Raina, the Centipede agent who kidnaps people with powers, starting in Hong Kong.
stages.whoA: A Centipede agent she hunts, starting in Hong Kong.
stages.whoB: An agent who hunts her, starting in Hong Kong.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May stands guard as Raina tries to blackmail Coulson into handing Skye over to her.
stages.whoA: A blackmailer she guards against as Raina demands Skye.
stages.whoB: An agent standing guard as she tries to blackmail Coulson for Skye.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. takes over the Playground, May slips past his agents, storms his office, and shoots him with an I.C.E.R. She later takes a seat on his council to help bring the two sides of S.H.I.E.L.D. together.
stages.whoA: A rival director she shoots with an I.C.E.R., then joins on his council.
stages.whoB: An agent who shoots him with an I.C.E.R., then joins his council.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Rosalind Price's ATCU takes in Andrew Garner after he turns into Lash, and she offers May the chance to put him in a medical coma to slow the change. May agrees after asking Daisy what she would do.
stages.whoA: The ATCU's head, who offers to put Andrew in a medical coma.
stages.whoB: Andrew's ex-wife, who agrees to put him in a medical coma.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Sif teams up with May to recapture the escaped sorceress Lorelei, and the two warriors bond over Sif's sword. Sif warns May that Lorelei once enchanted a man she cared for and urges her to be ready to do what is needed about Grant Ward.
stages.whoA: An Asgardian warrior who helps her recapture Lorelei and warns her about Ward.
stages.whoB: A fellow warrior who helps her recapture Lorelei and bonds over her sword.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi, disguised as Glenn Talbot, lures May into his hotel room, ties her up, and threatens to torture her for S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets. She breaks free and attacks him, and later she and Coulson hand him over to the real Talbot.
stages.whoA: A Hydra agent who poses as Talbot to capture and torture her.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he ties up, who breaks free and attacks him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Years ago in Russia, Melinda May steals an 0-8-4 from Anton Ivanov's unit, and his comrades are executed for the failure. Now calling himself the Superior, he blames May and Phil Coulson and wants them dead.
stages.whoA: Anton Ivanov, who wants her dead for the 0-8-4 she stole.
stages.whoB: The agent whose theft of an 0-8-4 got his comrades executed.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand takes command of the Bus while Coulson is missing, and May backs her decision to put Skye off the plane. During the Hydra Uprising, Hand takes over the Bus herself, unsure whose side May and the team are on.
stages.whoA: A commander who takes over the Bus and doubts her loyalty.
stages.whoB: Coulson's pilot, who backs her and whose loyalty she later doubts.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Werner von Strucker tries to kill May's ex-husband Andrew Garner on Grant Ward's orders. When May finds Werner being tortured by Kebo, she frees him, holds him as he bleeds, and learns from him that Garner has become Lash.
stages.whoA: The man who tried to kill Andrew, whom she frees and questions about Lash.
stages.whoB: Andrew's ex-wife, who frees him from Kebo and holds him as he bleeds.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk forces Melvin Potter to make armor and gear for him by threatening his friend Betsy.
stages.whoA: His forced employer, threatening Betsy to make him build armor.
stages.whoB: A craftsman he forces to make armor by threatening his friend Betsy.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Mephisto makes a deal with Riri Williams. She asks for her A.I. back, but he twists the bargain and returns her dead friend Natalie instead.
stages.whoA: A genius he bargains with, returning her dead friend instead of her A.I.
stages.whoB: A dealmaker who twists her bargain and returns Natalie instead of her A.I.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Parker Robbins struck a pact with Mephisto, who gave him the cloak that powers the Hood. The cloak slowly corrupts Robbins the longer he wears it.
stages.whoA: Parker Robbins, whom he gave the corrupting cloak in a pact.
stages.whoB: The one who gave him his cloak in a pact. It slowly corrupts him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Meredith Quill is Peter Quill's mother, who dies of cancer when he is a boy.
stages.whoA: Her son, a boy when she dies of cancer.
stages.whoB: His mother, who dies of cancer when he is a boy.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck tries to kill Michelle Jones because she knows about his illusions.
stages.whoA: Quentin Beck, who tries to kill her for knowing about his illusions.
stages.whoB: A girl who knows about his illusions, so he tries to kill her.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Michelle Jones starts out calling Ned and Peter losers at the lunch table, but she becomes one of Ned's closest friends.
stages.whoA: A lunch table loser who becomes one of her closest friends.
stages.whoB: A sharp classmate who calls him a loser, then becomes a close friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: After Peter's identity is exposed, she and Ned stand by him through the multiversal crisis. Even after the world forgets Peter, the two stay close and head off to MIT together.
stages.whoA: Her close friend. Even after the world forgets Peter, they head to MIT together.
stages.whoB: His close friend. Even after the world forgets Peter, they head to MIT together.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Michelle Jones is Peter's sharp, aloof classmate on the academic decathlon team, and she tells him her friends call her MJ.
stages.whoA: A classmate on the academic decathlon team.
stages.whoB: A sharp classmate on the decathlon team, whose friends call her MJ.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Peter plans to tell MJ how he feels on the class trip to Europe. She works out that he is Spider-Man, and the two fall in love.
stages.whoA: The boy she falls in love with, once she works out he is Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, who works out that he is Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: MJ stands by Peter after his identity is exposed. To save the world, Peter has everyone forget him, including her, and he chooses not to tell her who he was.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend, who makes the whole world forget him, her included.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend. To save the world, he lets her forget him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Years later Spider-Man saves MJ from a telepath, and she learns he is the Peter Parker she has forgotten. She cannot return his love without her memories, but she lets him back into her life as a friend.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the forgotten Peter Parker, back in her life as a friend.
stages.whoB: His lost love, who lets him back in as a friend without her memories.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington is MJ's teacher, and he names her captain of the academic decathlon team when Liz Allan leaves. He chaperones the trip to Washington, often caught off guard by her pointed remarks, like her refusal to enter a monument built by slaves.
stages.whoA: Her teacher, who makes her decathlon captain.
stages.whoB: His student and decathlon captain, quick with pointed remarks.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: The Grandmaster forces Miek to fight in his Contest of Champions on Sakaar. Once freed, Miek helps Korg lead the gladiators in a revolt against him.
stages.whoA: Sakaar's ruler, who forces him to fight, until Miek joins the revolt.
stages.whoB: A gladiator he forces to fight, who helps lead the revolt against him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke Shaw tracks down Mike Peterson while searching for agents still loyal to S.H.I.E.L.D., and Mike flies in with them to help save the Lighthouse. At Fitz and Simmons' wedding, Deke asks him which side he is on, and Mike says he knows them both.
stages.whoA: An agent who recruits him to help save the Lighthouse.
stages.whoB: A loyal agent he tracks down, who helps save the Lighthouse.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Edison Po works on Garrett's Centipede project, which uses Mike Peterson as a test subject.
stages.whoA: A Centipede scientist who experiments on him.
stages.whoB: A test subject in his Centipede project.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Under HYDRA's control, Deathlok ambushes Felix Blake during the hunt for the Clairvoyant and breaks his spine. When Blake begs him to remember his son Ace, Deathlok answers that Mike Peterson is dead.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he cripples while under Hydra's control.
stages.whoB: Deathlok, who breaks his spine and says Mike Peterson is dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Ian Quinn oversees Mike Peterson's Deathlok upgrades for the Clairvoyant. When Quinn pushes him to kill outside his orders, Mike refuses, saying she is not the one he is supposed to kill.
stages.whoA: His Deathlok handler, whose order to kill he refuses.
stages.whoB: Deathlok, whose upgrades he oversees, who refuses his order to kill.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jemma Simmons creates the cure that stabilizes the Extremis in Mike Peterson's body and saves his life.
stages.whoA: The scientist whose cure saves his life.
stages.whoB: A Centipede subject whose life she saves with her cure.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Once Mike is free of Hydra and joins Coulson's fight, she and Fitz test him and prepare him for missions.
stages.whoA: A scientist who, with Fitz, tests him and preps him for missions.
stages.whoB: A new ally she and Fitz test and prepare for missions.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: During the battle at Cybertek, Hydra forces Deathlok to turn his weapons on Nick Fury and Phil Coulson. Once Mike breaks free of John Garrett's hold, he kills Garrett while Fury looks on.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director Hydra forces him to target at Cybertek.
stages.whoB: Deathlok, who turns on him at Cybertek, then kills Garrett.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson's first mission with his new team is to find and help Mike Peterson, a factory worker made unstable by the Centipede serum.
stages.whoA: The agent sent to find and help him.
stages.whoB: A factory worker made unstable by Centipede, his team's first mission.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Hydra rebuilds Mike as the cyborg Deathlok and turns him against Coulson's team.
stages.whoA: The agent whose team Hydra turns him against.
stages.whoB: A man Hydra rebuilds as Deathlok and turns against his team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After Mike escapes Hydra's control, Coulson brings him into S.H.I.E.L.D., and Mike later rescues Coulson from Robert Gonzales' agents.
stages.whoA: The director who brings him into S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: Deathlok, now free, who joins S.H.I.E.L.D. and rescues him from Gonzales.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina recruits Mike Peterson into the Centipede Project, promising a treatment that will put him back to work after his injury. Her program turns him into one of HYDRA's super soldiers.
stages.whoA: The recruiter who brings him into Centipede with a promise of work.
stages.whoB: A recruit she turns into one of Hydra's super soldiers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Deathlok locks the brainwashed Sunil Bakshi in the trunk of a car and drives him to Coulson for the plan against HYDRA. He then poses as Bakshi's bodyguard so they can get close to Dr. List.
stages.whoA: A brainwashed Hydra agent he delivers to Coulson in a trunk.
stages.whoB: Deathlok, who drives him to Coulson in a trunk and poses as his bodyguard.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva holds Nick Fury at gunpoint when the Starforce captures him and Carol's allies aboard Mar-Vell's lab, then orders him and the Skrulls ejected into space.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent she holds at gunpoint and orders ejected.
stages.whoB: A Kree sniper who holds him at gunpoint and orders him ejected.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva hunts Talos and the Skrulls as part of Starforce. She chases the Quadjet carrying Talos and his people until Maria Rambeau shoots her down.
stages.whoA: A Skrull she hunts until Maria Rambeau shoots her down.
stages.whoB: A Kree sniper who hunts his people.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva is Starforce's sniper and serves under Yon-Rogg's command. In 1989 she flies with him to Earth to capture Mar-Vell and her light-speed engine, the mission that ends with Carol Danvers absorbing its power.
stages.whoA: Her commander in Starforce.
stages.whoB: Starforce's sniper, who flies with him to Earth to capture Mar-Vell.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Miss Minutes and Mobius work side by side at the TVA, but she distrusts him and later works against him.
stages.whoA: A fellow TVA worker she distrusts and works against.
stages.whoB: The TVA's mascot, who distrusts him and works against him.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Miss Minutes runs most of the Temporal Loom's work while Ouroboros only checks in for diagnostics every few hundred years. When she sabotages the effort to save the Loom, Ouroboros reboots the system to shut her down, and he later reprograms her to help the new TVA.
stages.whoA: The Loom's technician, who reboots the system to shut her down, then reprograms her.
stages.whoB: The Loom's A.I., who sabotages it until he shuts her down and reprograms her.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Miss Minutes is the TVA's clock mascot, and she helps Judge Ravonna Renslayer keep the agency running.
stages.whoA: The judge she helps keep the TVA running.
stages.whoB: The TVA's clock mascot, who helps her keep the agency running.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: After He Who Remains dies, Miss Minutes and Renslayer go rogue together, hunting for Victor Timely and plotting to take back the TVA.
stages.whoA: Her partner in going rogue, hunting Victor Timely to retake the TVA.
stages.whoB: Her rogue partner after He Who Remains dies, hunting Victor Timely.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Miss Minutes helps Renslayer string Sylvie along with a search for a Void timecraft that does not exist. She later appears to Sylvie and Loki at the Citadel at the End of Time, offering them a deal from He Who Remains.
stages.whoA: A variant she strings along with a fake timecraft, then offers a deal.
stages.whoB: The TVA's A.I., who strings her along, then offers He Who Remains' deal.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Miss Minutes tries to steer Victor Timely toward becoming He Who Remains. He refuses to go along with her.
stages.whoA: The man she steers toward becoming He Who Remains, who refuses her.
stages.whoB: The TVA's A.I., who tries to steer him into becoming He Who Remains.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty is a friend of Pop's and greets him warmly when her investigation brings her to his barbershop. She is shaken when he is killed in the shooting there, and attends his funeral.
stages.whoA: A friend whose barbershop she visits, killed there in a shooting.
stages.whoB: A detective friend who visits his barbershop.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Inspector Priscilla Ridley is Misty's commanding officer in the Harlem precinct.
stages.whoA: Her commanding officer in the Harlem precinct.
stages.whoB: A detective under her command in the Harlem precinct.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Rafael Scarfe takes Misty on as his partner when no other detective will work with her, teaching her everything she knows about police work. She is shattered to learn he has been on Cottonmouth's payroll, and he dies apologizing to her.
stages.whoA: Her partner and mentor, secretly on Cottonmouth's payroll, who dies apologizing to her.
stages.whoB: His partner and protégé. She learns he is dirty as he dies apologizing.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty spends years trying to bring down Shades, who kills Candace Miller, the witness she needs against Mariah Dillard.
stages.whoA: A gangster she hunts for years, who kills her key witness.
stages.whoB: A detective who has hunted him for years.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty keeps hunting Shades as he runs Mariah's operations, until he turns on Mariah and hands Misty the evidence to arrest her.
stages.whoA: Mariah's lieutenant, who finally hands her the evidence to arrest Mariah.
stages.whoB: A detective who hunts him until he hands her evidence against Mariah.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tilda Johnson helps Misty at first, but she turns out to be dangerous.
stages.whoA: Mariah's daughter, who helps her at first but turns out to be dangerous.
stages.whoB: A detective she helps at first, before showing her dangerous side.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Captain Tom Ridenhour was Misty's commanding officer and supported her until his death.
stages.whoA: Her captain, who supports her until his death.
stages.whoB: A detective under his command whom he supports until his death.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty runs into Turk Barrett outside Pop's barbershop and warns him off, surprised to see him so far from Hell's Kitchen. She later finds him where Luke left him and arrests him yet again.
stages.whoA: A Hell's Kitchen crook she warns off, then arrests yet again.
stages.whoB: A detective who warns him off in Harlem, then arrests him yet again.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty and Colleen turn to Ward Meachum when Danny goes missing, and he puts Rand Enterprises security on the search. When he bursts in on Misty fighting at Eden Towers and shoots her attacker, she thanks him and he tells her to call him Ward.
stages.whoA: Danny's old friend, who helps search for him and saves her at Eden Towers.
stages.whoB: A detective he saves at Eden Towers, and tells to call him Ward.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip and his crew open fire on Misty Knight and Luke Cage during the attack on Harlem's Paradise. Luke shields Misty behind the bar as Zip keeps shooting and complains that Luke is bulletproof.
stages.whoA: A gunman who opens fire on her and Luke at Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoB: A detective he shoots at in the attack on Harlem's Paradise.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Mitchell Carson and Peggy Carter are S.H.I.E.L.D. leaders when Hank Pym quits in 1989. Carson wants Pym stopped from leaving with his formula, and Peggy asks if he really wants to make Pym an enemy.
stages.whoA: A fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. leader who questions his push to stop Pym.
stages.whoB: A fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. leader who wants Pym stopped from leaving.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Ouroboros, the TVA's repair technician, once shared a friendly bond with Mobius, who nicknamed him O.B., but Mobius forgets him over the centuries. When they meet again, O.B. happily reminisces while Mobius pretends to remember, and the two work together to save the Temporal Loom.
stages.whoA: O.B., an old friend he forgot, who helps him save the Loom.
stages.whoB: An old friend who forgot him and pretends otherwise. They save the Loom.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Ravonna Renslayer is Mobius's superior and longtime friend, and she reluctantly lets him recruit Loki. When the case exposes the TVA's lies, she has Mobius pruned to protect the agency, and he escapes the Void to confront her.
stages.whoA: His superior and longtime friend, who has him pruned to protect the TVA.
stages.whoB: Her longtime friend and agent, whom she has pruned to protect the TVA.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Renslayer escapes the TVA and races Mobius and Loki to reach Victor Timely in 1893. When Mobius confronts her, she insists she has always put the TVA above her own happiness.
stages.whoA: His old friend, now a fugitive racing him to Victor Timely.
stages.whoB: Her old friend, who races her to Victor Timely and confronts her.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Mobius hunts Sylvie as the TVA's most dangerous variant and captures her on Lamentis-1. After he learns the TVA's lies and is pruned, he picks her up in the Void and backs her plan to enchant Alioth.
stages.whoA: The variant he hunts and captures, then helps against Alioth.
stages.whoB: The agent who captures her, then backs her plan to enchant Alioth.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Mobius takes Victor Timely to the TVA and works with him to fix the Temporal Loom.
stages.whoA: The man he brings to the TVA to fix the Loom.
stages.whoB: The agent who brings him to the TVA to fix the Loom.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Mole Man is a former enemy of Reed's team who becomes an ally and helps them during the crisis with Galactus.
stages.whoA: The leader of the team he once fought, now an ally against Galactus.
stages.whoB: A former enemy who helps the team against Galactus.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Sue Storm wins over the Mole Man, a former enemy, and he becomes a friend who helps the team.
stages.whoA: The woman who wins him over, turning an old enemy into a friend.
stages.whoB: A former enemy she wins over, who becomes a friend to the team.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Nick Fury meets Monica Rambeau as a young girl in 1995, when he and Carol Danvers hide out at her mother's home.
stages.whoA: A man who hides out at her mother's home with Carol.
stages.whoB: Maria Rambeau's young daughter, whom he meets hiding out at her home.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Years later Fury works with the grown Monica from S.A.B.E.R. and calls on her when the jump points start acting up.
stages.whoA: An old friend who calls her in when the jump points act up.
stages.whoB: The grown Monica, whom he calls on when the jump points act up.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica Rambeau jumps in front of Tommy and Billy and stops Tyler Hayward's bullets during the battle in Westview.
stages.whoA: One of Wanda's twins, whom she shields from Hayward's bullets.
stages.whoB: The agent who stops Hayward's bullets to save him and Billy.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward is Monica Rambeau's superior at S.W.O.R.D. She turns against him once she learns his plans.
stages.whoA: Her superior at S.W.O.R.D., whom she turns against.
stages.whoB: An agent under him at S.W.O.R.D., who turns against him.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: When Monica enters Westview, Wanda's Hex turns her into "Geraldine," a neighbor who befriends Wanda. After Wanda throws her out, Monica keeps trying to reach her and helps her rather than fighting her.
stages.whoA: The woman whose Hex makes her Geraldine, and whom she tries to help.
stages.whoB: Geraldine, a friendly neighbor, then the agent who keeps trying to help her.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Morgan Stark is Pepper Potts' daughter, and Pepper raises her after Tony Stark dies.
stages.whoA: Her mother, who raises her after Tony dies.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, whom she raises after Tony dies.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Morgan Stark is the daughter of Tony Stark and Pepper Potts. Tony gives his life so she can grow up in a world that survived Thanos.
stages.whoA: Her dad, who gives his life so she can grow up.
stages.whoB: His daughter, for whom he gives his life to defeat Thanos.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Morris, a faceless winged creature from Ta Lo, guides Shang-Chi through the shifting forest to his mother's homeland.
stages.whoA: The young man he guides through the forest to Ta Lo.
stages.whoB: A faceless winged creature who guides him to his mother's homeland.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Morris is Trevor Slattery's constant companion during his years as Wenwu's prisoner.
stages.whoA: His fellow prisoner and constant companion in Wenwu's dungeon.
stages.whoB: His constant companion during his years as Wenwu's prisoner.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wenwu finds Morris in the bamboo forest on one of his searches for the way to Ta Lo and takes him back to the Ten Rings compound. There Morris is thrown into the dungeon, where he befriends Trevor Slattery.
stages.whoA: The warlord who captures him and throws him in the dungeon.
stages.whoB: A creature from Ta Lo he captures and throws in his dungeon.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is a CIA agent who works for Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, recruiting enhanced people for her.
stages.whoA: His boss, for whom he recruits enhanced people.
stages.whoB: A CIA agent who recruits enhanced people for her.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles deals with Vanessa Fisk while running a weapons smuggling scheme with the Fisks.
stages.whoA: Fisk's wife, his contact in their weapons smuggling scheme.
stages.whoB: A CIA agent she deals with in the weapons smuggling scheme.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is a CIA agent who teams up with Fisk to smuggle weapons through New York. Their alliance breaks down when Fisk betrays him.
stages.whoA: His partner in smuggling weapons, until Fisk betrays him.
stages.whoB: A CIA agent he smuggles weapons with, then betrays.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki Ramos helps Mallory Book handle Mr. Immortal's divorce case at GLK&H.
stages.whoA: A paralegal who helps handle his divorce case.
stages.whoB: A client whose divorce case she helps Mallory Book handle.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sana is Muneeba's mother. Muneeba brings Kamala to visit her in Karachi and finally reconciles with her.
stages.whoA: Her mother, with whom she finally reconciles in Karachi.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, who visits with Kamala and finally reconciles with her.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Tyesha Hillman marries Muneeba's son Aamir, making her Muneeba's daughter-in-law.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Nobu Yoshioka is Murakami's second in command in the Hand, sent to New York to act on his behalf. Murakami stays in the shadows while Nobu deals with Wilson Fisk and works to claim a city block for the Hand.

stages.text: Stick knows Murakami as the hidden power who pulled Nobu's strings in the Hand. When the Hand holds the Defenders, Stick helps them break free from Murakami's grasp.
stages.whoA: An old foe who helps the Defenders break free of his grasp.
stages.whoB: The hidden power behind Nobu in the Hand.

stages.text: Murakami is sent to kidnap Trish Walker so the Hand can trade her for Sowande. Jessica Jones fights him off and takes Trish to safety.
stages.whoA: A target he is sent to kidnap, until Jessica fights him off.
stages.whoB: A Hand leader sent to kidnap her for a trade, stopped by Jessica.

stages.whoA: The mayor who uses his murders to push the crackdown on vigilantes.
stages.whoB: A serial killer whose murders he uses to push his crackdown.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Ned is on the class trip when Quentin Beck stages his Elemental attacks, and he and Betty are the ones who coin the name Mysterio. Once Ned learns the truth, Beck sends his drones after him and his friends in London.
stages.whoA: A student who coins his name, then dodges his drones in London.
stages.whoB: The fake hero he helps name, who sends drones after him in London.

stages.text: Quentin Beck poses as a hero to win Peter Parker's trust, then tries to kill him. With his last act he frames Peter and reveals his identity.
stages.whoA: The hero he fools, tries to kill, and finally frames and unmasks.
stages.whoB: A fake hero who wins his trust, tries to kill him, and exposes him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Posing as Maria Hill, Soren works alongside Quentin Beck against the Elementals, not knowing they are his illusions. Beck keeps her and Talos fooled until his fraud is exposed.
stages.whoA: A Skrull posing as Maria Hill, fooled by his illusions.
stages.whoB: A fraud whose fake Elementals keep her fooled.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck fools Talos, who is posing as Nick Fury, with his illusions.
stages.whoA: A Skrull posing as Nick Fury, fooled by his illusions.
stages.whoB: A fraud who fools him with illusions while he poses as Fury.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck invents a holographic technology at Stark Industries, and Tony Stark rebrands it and fires him. Bitter at being cast aside, Beck becomes Mysterio and schemes to take Tony's legacy for himself.
stages.whoA: His old boss, who rebrands his invention and fires him.
stages.whoB: A fired employee who becomes Mysterio to take his legacy.

stages.text: William Riva is Quentin Beck's partner and helps run the illusions behind Mysterio.
stages.whoA: His partner, who helps run the Mysterio illusions.
stages.whoB: Quentin Beck, the boss he helps run the Mysterio illusions for.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is Ramonda's brother-in-law, the younger brother of her husband T'Chaka. When N'Jobu's son Erik Killmonger arrives in Wakanda, Ramonda calls him a liar until he produces N'Jobu's royal ring.
stages.whoA: His sister-in-law, the wife of his brother T'Chaka.
stages.whoB: Her husband's younger brother, whose ring his son Erik brings to Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is Shuri's uncle, killed by her father T'Chaka years before she is born. T'Challa later brings her to the Oakland building where it happened, which he turns into Wakanda's first outreach center.
stages.whoA: His niece, born years after T'Chaka kills him.
stages.whoB: Her uncle, killed by her father before she is born.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is T'Chaka's younger brother. T'Chaka kills him when N'Jobu betrays Wakanda.
stages.whoA: His older brother, who kills him when he betrays Wakanda.
stages.whoB: His younger brother, whom he kills for betraying Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is T'Challa's uncle, killed by T'Chaka for betraying Wakanda.
stages.whoA: His nephew, T'Chaka's son.
stages.whoB: His uncle, killed by T'Chaka for betraying Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is King T'Chaka's brother, which makes him the great-uncle of Toussaint through his father, T'Challa. He dies long before Toussaint is born.
stages.whoA: His great-nephew, T'Challa's son, born long after N'Jobu's death.
stages.whoB: His great-uncle, T'Chaka's brother, who died long before he was born.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu recruits Ulysses Klaue in 1992 and secretly helps him steal a quarter ton of vibranium from Wakanda, hoping to arm oppressed people around the world. The raid kills many Wakandans, and T'Chaka confronts N'Jobu for being Klaue's man on the inside.
stages.whoA: The smuggler he helps steal Wakanda's vibranium.
stages.whoB: His inside man in the vibranium raid on Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zuri poses as N'Jobu's friend in Oakland while secretly spying on him for T'Chaka. When Zuri is exposed, N'Jobu draws a gun on him, and T'Chaka kills N'Jobu to save him.
stages.whoA: A false friend in Oakland, secretly spying on him for T'Chaka.
stages.whoB: The man he spies on in Oakland, who pulls a gun on him.

stages.whoA: The Red Dagger leader she kills in the raid on his hideout.
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who kills him in the raid on the Red Daggers' hideout.

stages.whoA: Talokan's king, who attacks Wakanda after she kills his guard.
stages.whoB: A Wakandan who frees Shuri and Riri from Talokan and kills his guard.

stages.whoA: An old friend who clashes with her over duty, then fights beside her.
stages.whoB: An old friend who asks her to flee, then fights beside her.

stages.whoB: A spy who gets her and Shuri to safety among the Jabari.

stages.text: Years later, after T'Challa's death, Ramonda seeks Nakia out in Haiti to help rescue Shuri from Talokan.
stages.whoA: The queen who seeks her out in Haiti to rescue Shuri.
stages.whoB: T'Challa's old love, whom she seeks out in Haiti to save Shuri.

stages.text: Nakia sneaks into Talokan and rescues Riri and Shuri from Namor's guards.

stages.whoA: A close friend she fights beside when Killmonger seizes the throne.
stages.whoB: A close friend who fights beside her against Killmonger.

stages.text: After T'Challa dies, Nakia rescues Shuri from Talokan and later introduces her to Toussaint, the son Nakia had with T'Challa.
stages.whoA: Her close friend, whom she rescues and introduces to Toussaint.
stages.whoB: A close friend who rescues her and introduces her to her nephew Toussaint.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia is a War Dog spy and the woman T'Challa loves, and she pushes him to open Wakanda up to the world.
stages.whoA: The king she loves, whom she pushes to open Wakanda.
stages.whoB: The woman he loves, a War Dog spy who wants Wakanda open.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Nakia and T'Challa have a son, Toussaint, and after T'Challa's death she raises him in Haiti, away from the throne.

stages.whoB: The mother of his son, Toussaint, whom she raises in Haiti.

stages.text: Toussaint is the son of Nakia, who raises him in Haiti away from the throne.
stages.whoA: Her son, whom she raises in Haiti away from the throne.
stages.whoB: His mother, who raises him in Haiti away from the throne.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia joins the Busan mission to capture Ulysses Klaue and chases him across the city with Okoye until his sonic arm blasts their car apart. Once he is caught, she talks T'Challa out of killing him in front of the crowd.
stages.whoA: An arms dealer she chases in Busan, then talks T'Challa out of killing.
stages.whoB: A Wakandan spy who chases him through Busan.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi opposes Nakia's hope of opening Wakanda to refugees, warning T'Challa against it. He later backs Erik Killmonger, and his Border Tribe traps Nakia and her allies behind energy shields at Mount Bashenga.
stages.whoA: The Border Tribe's leader, who opposes her and traps her at Mount Bashenga.
stages.whoB: A spy whose refugee plan he opposes, and whom he traps behind shields.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir confronts Sadie Deever when Damage Control tries to search the mosque, and fights her agents at Coles High.
stages.whoA: The Damage Control agent she confronts over searching the mosque.
stages.whoB: A teen who confronts her over the mosque and fights her agents.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir runs for the mosque board, and she stands with Sheikh Abdullah to stop Damage Control from searching the mosque without a warrant.
stages.whoA: Her mosque's leader, who stands with her against Damage Control.
stages.whoB: A mosque board candidate who stands with him against Damage Control.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir and Zoe Zimmer were close as children, drifted apart and become friends again.
stages.whoA: A childhood friend she drifts from, then befriends again.
stages.whoB: A childhood friend she drifts from, then befriends again.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor is the king Namora has idolized since childhood. She serves as his second-in-command and close advisor.
stages.whoA: His second-in-command and close advisor.
stages.whoB: Her king, whom she has idolized since childhood.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Okoye is stripped of her rank after Namor's warriors take Shuri on her watch in Boston. She returns as Midnight Angel to fight his Talokanil at sea.
stages.whoA: A Wakandan general who returns as Midnight Angel to fight his warriors.
stages.whoB: The king whose warriors take Shuri on her watch, costing her rank.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor floods Wakanda's capital in his attack on the country. Queen Ramonda drowns in the attack while saving Riri Williams.
stages.whoA: The queen who drowns when he floods her capital.
stages.whoB: The king whose flood drowns her as she saves Riri.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor wants Riri Williams dead because her vibranium detector threatens Talokan's secrecy. Wakanda refuses to hand her over, which starts his war on Wakanda.
stages.whoA: The inventor he wants dead for threatening Talokan's secrecy.
stages.whoB: A king who wants her dead because of her vibranium detector.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor takes Shuri to Talokan and shows her his kingdom, hoping to make her an ally. After he kills Queen Ramonda, Shuri defeats him in battle and spares him in exchange for peace.
stages.whoA: Wakanda's princess, whom he courts as an ally, then fights. She spares him.
stages.whoB: The king who shows her Talokan, then kills her mother. She spares him.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namora joins the Talokanil ambush on Okoye, Shuri and Riri Williams in Cambridge. She hands Attuma the water bomb he deflects into Okoye, sending her off the bridge just as Shuri is taken.
stages.whoA: A Wakandan general she helps knock off a bridge in Cambridge.
stages.whoB: A Talokanil warrior who helps ambush her and knock her off a bridge.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namora helps kidnap Riri Williams and takes her to Talokan, because Namor wants the inventor of the vibranium detector dead.
stages.whoA: The inventor she kidnaps and takes to Talokan.
stages.whoB: A Talokanil warrior who kidnaps her for Namor.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namora guards Shuri during her captivity in Talokan and fights Wakanda's forces in the war that follows.
stages.whoA: Wakanda's princess, whom she guards in Talokan and fights in the war.
stages.whoB: Her guard in Talokan and a foe in the war that follows.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Natalie Washington is Riri's best friend, killed in the same drive-by shooting as Riri's stepfather. Riri builds her A.I. in Natalie's image, and Natalie later returns through Mephisto's deal.
stages.whoA: Her best friend, who builds an A.I. in her image.
stages.whoB: Her best friend, killed in a drive-by, who returns through Mephisto's deal.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Natalie Washington is Xavier's sister, and the two grow up hanging around Gary Williams's auto shop with their friend Riri. After Natalie is killed in a drive-by shooting, Xavier listens to her old mixtape whenever he wishes he could talk to her.
stages.whoA: Her brother, who grows up with her at Gary Williams's shop.
stages.whoB: His sister, killed in a drive-by. He plays her mixtape to feel close.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Nathaniel is named after Natasha, his parents' close friend and the children's honorary aunt. Clint and Laura first plan to call their baby Natasha, and send her a video of the newborn.
stages.whoA: Clint and Laura's baby boy, named after her.
stages.whoB: His honorary aunt, whom his parents name him after.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Nebula serves in the Avengers that Natasha leads in the five years after the Snap. On the time heist, Natasha travels with Nebula, Clint and Rhodey before they split up for Vormir and Morag.
stages.whoA: An Avenger under her command, who goes with her on the time heist.
stages.whoB: The leader of the Avengers she serves in after the Snap.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Nick Fury is Natasha Romanoff's director at S.H.I.E.L.D., and he sends her undercover to keep an eye on Tony Stark.
stages.whoA: Her director, who sends her undercover to watch Tony Stark.
stages.whoB: His agent, sent undercover to keep an eye on Tony Stark.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Fury is one of the few people Natasha fully trusts. When Hydra is exposed, she fights at his side to bring S.H.I.E.L.D. down.
stages.whoA: One of the few people she fully trusts. She fights by his side.
stages.whoB: A trusted friend who fights at his side to bring down S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye and Natasha first fight side by side against Proxima Midnight to save Wanda in Wakanda.
stages.whoA: The Dora Milaje's general, who fights beside her in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: An Avenger who fights beside her against Proxima Midnight.

stages.text: After the Snap, Okoye joins the Avengers under Natasha's command while still leading the Dora Milaje.
stages.whoA: An Avenger under her command, still leading the Dora Milaje.
stages.whoB: The leader of the Avengers she joins after the Snap.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Natalie Rushman brings Pepper Potts the paperwork for her promotion to CEO, and Tony hires Natalie on the spot as his assistant, to Pepper's annoyance. Pepper has no idea Natalie is really Natasha Romanoff, sent by S.H.I.E.L.D. to watch Tony.
stages.whoA: Tony's new CEO, who is annoyed when Tony hires her.
stages.whoB: Natalie Rushman, Tony's new assistant, secretly a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.

stages.text: Phil Coulson and Natasha Romanoff are S.H.I.E.L.D. colleagues who work the Tony Stark assignment together.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague on the Tony Stark assignment.
stages.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague on the Tony Stark assignment.

stages.text: When Loki takes Clint Barton, Coulson pulls Natasha out of an interrogation to bring her in.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent who pulls her out of an interrogation to bring her in.
stages.whoB: A fellow agent he pulls from an interrogation when Loki takes Clint.

stages.text: Natasha fights Proxima Midnight in Edinburgh to rescue Wanda and Vision. They clash again in Wakanda, where Proxima nearly kills her and Okoye before Wanda throws her into a Thresher.
stages.whoA: A Black Order warrior who nearly kills her in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: An Avenger she fights in Edinburgh and Wakanda.

stages.text: As Vormir's Stonekeeper, the Red Skull tells Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton that the Soul Stone demands a life. Natasha sacrifices herself.

stages.whoB: The Avenger who gives her life for the Soul Stone.

stages.text: Rick Mason is Natasha Romanoff's old friend and supplier, who gets her whatever she needs while she is on the run.
stages.whoA: Her old friend and supplier, who gets her what she needs.
stages.whoB: An old friend he supplies with whatever she needs on the run.

stages.text: After the Snap, Rocket spends five years as a member of the Avengers under Natasha's command. He flies her, Steve and Rhodey on their first trip into space to confront Thanos.
stages.whoA: An Avenger under her command, who flies her to confront Thanos.
stages.whoB: The leader of the Avengers he serves with after the Snap.

stages.text: Natasha and Sam fight alongside Steve Rogers to expose Hydra and stop Project Insight.
stages.whoA: A friend who fights beside her to stop Project Insight.
stages.whoB: A friend who fights beside him to expose Hydra.

stages.text: After the Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, they spend two years on the run together with Steve.

stages.whoB: A friend and fellow fugitive on the run with Steve.

stages.whoB: An Avenger who fights him at the airport over the Accords.

stages.text: Five years after the Snap, Scott turns up at the Avengers Compound and pitches Natasha and Steve the idea of a time heist.

stages.whoB: An Avenger he pitches the time heist to.

stages.text: Natasha keeps nudging Steve to ask out his neighbor Sharon, who turns out to be Agent 13, sent by Fury to watch over him.

stages.text: They go on the run together when Hydra takes over S.H.I.E.L.D., and they become close friends.
stages.whoA: A close friend she goes on the run with when Hydra takes over.
stages.whoB: A close friend he goes on the run with when Hydra takes over.

stages.text: After the Snap, Steve and Natasha hold the remaining Avengers together for five years, until Natasha gives her life on Vormir.

stages.whoB: His close friend, who gives her life on Vormir.

stages.text: Thaddeus Ross presents the Sokovia Accords to the Avengers, and Natasha signs them. When she helps Steve and Bucky escape at the airport, she becomes a fugitive from Ross.

stages.whoB: Natalie Rushman, his assistant, secretly assessing him for S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.whoB: A Guardian he fights beside and webs to safety on Titan.

stages.text: Nebula is one of Ronan's lieutenants, chasing Gamora and Quill across the galaxy for the Orb.

stages.whoB: One of Ronan's lieutenants, chasing him and Gamora for the Orb.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula comes after Gamora again on Ego's planet, but she ends up fighting beside Quill and the Guardians against Ego before leaving to hunt Thanos.
