stages.whoB: Gamora's sister, who fights beside him against Ego, then leaves.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Nebula joins the fight against Thanos on Titan, and her revelation that Thanos killed Gamora sends Quill into a rage.
stages.whoA: An ally on Titan, whom her news about Gamora sends into a rage.
stages.whoB: An ally on Titan who reveals Thanos killed Gamora.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Nebula, Drax and Mantis find Phyla and the other captive children aboard the High Evolutionary's ship. After the rescue, Nebula stays on Knowhere to help raise them, and Phyla pulls her in to dance.
stages.whoA: A rescued child she helps raise on Knowhere, who pulls her in to dance.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who rescues her and stays on Knowhere to help raise her.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight and Nebula are both adopted daughters of Thanos, though Nebula despises her and the rest of the Black Order.
stages.whoA: Her adopted sister in Thanos's family, whom she despises.
stages.whoB: Her adopted sister, who despises her and the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Nebula and Rocket are the only Guardians to survive the Snap, and they spend the next five years as Avengers together.
stages.whoA: A fellow Guardian who survives the Snap and serves with her as an Avenger.
stages.whoB: A fellow Guardian who survives the Snap and serves with him as an Avenger.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After the Blip they are teammates on the Guardians, and Nebula fights to save Rocket's life when Adam Warlock wounds him.
stages.whoA: A teammate on the Guardians whose life she fights to save.
stages.whoB: A teammate on the Guardians who fights to save his life.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Thanos assigns Nebula to Ronan the Accuser to help him get the Orb. When Ronan turns on Thanos and keeps the Power Stone for himself, Nebula sides with him out of hatred for her father and fights for him over Xandar.
stages.whoA: The Kree warlord she is sent to help, then sides with against Thanos.
stages.whoB: Thanos's daughter, who sides with him when he turns on her father.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Scott tells Nebula she looks awesome when they meet at the Avengers Compound, and she calls him an idiot. She helps Bruce Banner fit him into a Time Suit for the time heist.
stages.whoA: Ant-Man, who calls her awesome. She calls him an idiot.
stages.whoB: A Guardian he calls awesome, who calls him an idiot.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Nebula joins Steve Rogers and the surviving Avengers after returning to Earth with Tony Stark. She leads them to Thanos on his garden planet and goes on the Time Heist.
stages.whoA: An Avenger she joins and leads to Thanos's garden planet.
stages.whoB: An ally who leads the Avengers to Thanos and joins the Time Heist.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula joins Taserface's mutiny against Yondu, stopping Taserface from killing Rocket and shooting Yondu's control fin off. Once she has a ship, she leaves the Ravagers to hunt down Gamora.
stages.whoA: The mutineer she joins against Yondu, then leaves.
stages.whoB: An ally in his mutiny, who shoots off Yondu's fin, then leaves.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Thanos adopts Nebula and replaces parts of her body each time she loses to Gamora, and she grows to hate him.
stages.whoA: Her adoptive father, who rebuilds her body each time she loses.
stages.whoB: His adopted daughter, who grows to hate him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos catches Nebula sneaking aboard his ship and tortures her until Gamora gives up the Soul Stone's location. Nebula escapes and joins the fight against him on Titan.
stages.whoA: Her father, who tortures her to break Gamora.
stages.whoB: His daughter, whom he tortures to make Gamora talk.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Nebula leads the Avengers to Thanos and helps them defeat him in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Her father, whom she helps the Avengers defeat.
stages.whoB: His daughter, who leads the Avengers to him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary captures Nebula, Drax and Mantis aboard his ship and threatens them to make Quill hand over Rocket. Nebula fights with the Guardians to bring him down and free his captives.
stages.whoA: The scientist who captures her and threatens her to get Rocket.
stages.whoB: A Guardian he captures, who helps bring him down.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Nebula and Tony Stark are left behind on Titan together after Thanos wins.
stages.whoA: The man left behind with her on Titan.
stages.whoB: A Guardian left behind with him on Titan.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Stranded in space on the way home, Nebula and Tony become friends, and she plays paper football with him to pass the time.
stages.whoA: A friend made in space, who plays paper football with her.
stages.whoB: A friend made in space, who plays paper football with him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula sides with Taserface's mutiny against Yondu and shoots the control fin off his head. Later they end up on the same side in the battle against Ego.
stages.whoA: The Ravager captain she helps overthrow, then fights beside against Ego.
stages.whoB: A mutineer who shoots off his fin, then ends up on his side.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned Leeds is Peter Parker's best friend from school. Once he learns Peter's secret, he helps him from behind a computer as his guy in the chair.
stages.whoA: His best friend, whose guy in the chair he becomes.
stages.whoB: His best friend and guy in the chair.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Ned helps Peter face the villains from other worlds. To save the world, Peter has everyone forget him, and Ned says a tearful goodbye to his best friend.
stages.whoA: His best friend, who makes the world forget him. Ned says a tearful goodbye.
stages.whoB: His best friend, who helps him face the villains, then forgets him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Years later Ned, who no longer remembers Peter, tracks Spider-Man's sightings with an app he built. He finally meets the hero face to face, and then meets Peter again.
stages.whoA: A forgotten best friend. Ned tracks Spider-Man, then meets Peter again.
stages.whoB: His forgotten best friend, who tracks Spider-Man with an app he built.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington is Ned's teacher and coaches the academic decathlon team Ned competes on, chaperoning the team's trip to Washington for Nationals.
stages.whoA: His teacher and academic decathlon coach.
stages.whoB: His student on the academic decathlon team.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Doctor Strange brings Ned and MJ to the Sanctum to help round up the visitors from other universes, and Ned surprises him by opening portals with the Sling Ring. One of those portals frees Strange from the Mirror Dimension, and Ned and MJ then talk him into giving Peter's plan a chance.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange, whom he frees from the Mirror Dimension with a portal.
stages.whoB: Peter's friend, who frees him from the Mirror Dimension with the Sling Ring.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon is Gravik's lieutenant among the Skrull rebels and warns him that Nick Fury is back on Earth. During the attack on President Ritson, he drags Gravik away after Fury shoots him.
stages.whoA: Gravik's lieutenant, who drags Gravik away after Fury shoots him.
stages.whoB: Gravik's enemy. Pagon warns he is back, then saves Gravik from his bullets.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Phil Coulson is one of Nick Fury's most trusted agents at S.H.I.E.L.D., working under him from 1995 on.
stages.whoA: One of his most trusted agents, working under him from 1995 on.
stages.whoB: His director at S.H.I.E.L.D., under whom he works from 1995 on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After Loki kills Coulson, Fury secretly brings him back through Project T.A.H.I.T.I. When S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Fury makes Coulson director of a new S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: The agent he secretly brings back to life, then names director.
stages.whoB: His boss, who secretly brings him back and makes him director.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Raava, posing as James Rhodes, uses her position to undercut Nick Fury. Fury kills her when he unmasks her.
stages.whoA: A Skrull posing as Rhodes, whom he kills when he unmasks her.
stages.whoB: The spy she undercuts while posing as Rhodes, who kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales joins S.H.I.E.L.D. young under Nick Fury and commands the Iliad when Hydra rises. He first insists on following Fury's order to blow up the ship, but later admits that doing so would have killed hundreds of agents.
stages.whoA: An agent who joined under him young and commands the Iliad when Hydra rises.
stages.whoB: His old director, whose order to sink the Iliad he nearly carries out.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Nick Fury assigns Agent 13, Sharon Carter, to protect Steve Rogers by posing as his next door neighbor. She is on guard the night the Winter Soldier ambushes Fury in Steve's apartment.
stages.whoA: Agent 13, whom he assigns to protect Steve as his neighbor.
stages.whoB: Her director, who assigns her to guard Steve as his neighbor.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sonya Falsworth is Nick Fury's old friend and fellow spy at MI6. She helps him hunt the Skrull rebels while pursuing Britain's own interests.
stages.whoA: An old friend and MI6 spy who helps him hunt the Skrull rebels.
stages.whoB: An old friend and fellow spy, whom she helps hunt the Skrull rebels.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Soren is Talos' wife, one of the Skrull refugees Nick Fury helps escape the Kree in 1995.
stages.whoA: Talos' wife, one of the Skrull refugees he helps escape the Kree.
stages.whoB: The man who helps her and her people escape the Kree.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Soren now works for Fury, and while he is away in space she poses as Maria Hill on Earth to cover for him.
stages.whoA: Talos' wife, who covers for him on Earth posing as Maria Hill.
stages.whoB: Her boss, for whom she poses as Maria Hill while he is in space.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Nick Fury is the first to greet Steve Rogers when he wakes up in the present after decades in the ice.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whom he greets on waking from the ice.
stages.whoB: The first man to greet him when he wakes from the ice.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Fury recruits Steve into S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Avengers, and Steve works his missions despite distrusting Fury's secrets.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whom he recruits to the Avengers despite Steve's distrust.
stages.whoB: His boss, who recruits him to the Avengers and keeps too many secrets.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Hydra comes for Fury, he turns to Steve, and together they bring S.H.I.E.L.D. down.
stages.whoA: The man he turns to when Hydra comes for him.
stages.whoB: His old boss, now his ally in bringing S.H.I.E.L.D. down.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Talos and Nick Fury become friends in 1995, after Fury helps the Skrulls escape the Kree.
stages.whoA: A Skrull who becomes his friend after he helps his people escape.
stages.whoB: A human who becomes his friend by helping the Skrulls escape the Kree.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Talos now works for Fury, posing as him on Earth while the real Fury is away in space.
stages.whoA: His Skrull friend, who poses as him on Earth while he is in space.
stages.whoB: His friend and boss, whom he poses as on Earth.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury comes back to Earth to help Talos stop Gravik's rebel Skrulls, though Talos resents that Fury never found his people a home. Talos dies at Gravik's hands before the fight is over.
stages.whoA: His old friend, resentful he never found the Skrulls a home. Gravik kills him.
stages.whoB: His old friend, who comes back to help stop Gravik's rebels.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Nick Fury approaches Tony Stark about the Avengers Initiative after Tony goes public as Iron Man.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, whom he approaches about the Avengers Initiative.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director who pitches him the Avengers Initiative.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Fury calls Tony in to fight Loki, and despite their clashes over S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets, Tony becomes one of the founding Avengers.
stages.whoA: A founding Avenger he calls in to fight Loki, despite their clashes.
stages.whoB: The director who calls him in to fight Loki, and keeps too many secrets.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Varra, a Skrull who lives as Priscilla, is Nick Fury's wife. Their marriage is strained by his long absences and secrets.
stages.whoA: His wife, a Skrull living as Priscilla, strained by his absences.
stages.whoB: Her husband, whose long absences and secrets strain their marriage.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Yon-Rogg leads the Kree soldiers who corner Nick Fury, Carol Danvers and their allies in Mar-Vell's hidden lab and take them prisoner. Fury breaks free and escapes with the Skrull refugees as Yon-Rogg tries to stop their ship.
stages.whoA: The Kree commander who captures him in Mar-Vell's lab.
stages.whoB: A prisoner who escapes his grasp with the Skrull refugees.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki Ramos helps expose Todd Phelps as HulkKing, the leader of Intelligencia.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, Intelligencia's leader, whom she helps expose.
stages.whoB: A paralegal who helps expose him as HulkKing.

stages.text: Nikki Ramos tracks down Wong for Jennifer and later calls him for help when Blonsky leaves his monitored area.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer she tracks down for Jen and calls about Blonsky.
stages.whoB: Jen's paralegal, who calls him when Blonsky leaves his monitored area.

stages.text: Stick has spent his life fighting the Hand, and Nobu is one of its leaders in New York. After Matt Murdock defeats Nobu, Stick cuts off his head so he cannot rise again.
stages.whoA: The Hand's lifelong foe, who cuts off his head.
stages.whoB: A Hand leader whose head he cuts off so he cannot rise again.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Nobu represents the Hand in Fisk's alliance and pushes him to clear the tenants from a building the Hand wants. Fisk lures Daredevil into a fight with Nobu that ends with Nobu burning.
stages.whoA: An ally who lures Daredevil into the fight that leaves Nobu burning.
stages.whoB: The Hand's man in his alliance, pushing him to clear a building.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Noni is sent to bring back the Lion, a rogue War Dogs captain who stole Wakandan weapons. She infiltrates his kingdom and fights him.
stages.whoA: A rogue War Dogs captain she is sent to bring back.
stages.whoB: A War Dog sent to bring him back, who infiltrates his kingdom.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Peter Quill warns the Nova Corps that Ronan is coming to destroy Xandar. Nova Prime Irani Rael chooses to trust him despite his criminal record and leads Xandar's defense alongside the Guardians.
stages.whoA: A thief she chooses to trust, who helps defend Xandar.
stages.whoB: The Nova Prime who trusts his warning and leads Xandar's defense.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nova Prime Irani Rael is Rhomann Dey's commanding officer. Dey brings her Peter Quill's warning that Ronan is coming for Xandar, and she trusts his judgment enough to act on it.
stages.whoA: Her officer, whose judgment she trusts on Quill's warning.
stages.whoB: His commanding officer, who acts on the warning he brings.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nova Prime Irani Rael leads Xandar's defense when Ronan the Accuser comes to wipe out her planet with the Power Stone. She orders the Nova Corps to form a blockade around his ship, and with the Guardians' help Xandar survives.
stages.whoA: The Kree fanatic who comes to wipe out her planet.
stages.whoB: Xandar's leader, whose Nova Corps blockade his ship.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Pepper Potts discovers Obadiah Stane's betrayal, and she triggers the reactor overload that kills him.
stages.whoA: Tony's assistant, who uncovers his betrayal and overloads the reactor on him.
stages.whoB: Tony's mentor, whose betrayal she uncovers. She triggers the overload that kills him.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Obadiah Stane hires Raza's Ten Rings cell to kill Tony Stark. Later he betrays Raza and takes the armor for himself.
stages.whoA: The terrorist he hires to kill Tony, then betrays.
stages.whoB: The man who hires his cell to kill Tony, then betrays him.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Obadiah Stane is Tony Stark's mentor at Stark Industries. Secretly he pays to have Tony killed, then steals his armor design and fights him as the Iron Monger.
stages.whoA: His protégé, whom he pays to have killed, then fights as Iron Monger.
stages.whoB: His mentor, who pays to have him killed and fights him as Iron Monger.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: William Ginter Riva is the Stark Industries scientist Obadiah Stane puts in charge of copying Tony Stark's arc reactor for his own armor. When Riva says it cannot be done, Stane snaps that Tony built one in a cave with a box of scraps.
stages.whoA: His scientist, ordered to copy Tony's arc reactor.
stages.whoB: His boss, who snaps that Tony built a reactor in a cave.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Odin is Thor's father and the king of Asgard, and he banishes Thor to Earth for his arrogance.
stages.whoA: His son, banished to Earth for his arrogance.
stages.whoB: His father, the king of Asgard, who banishes him to Earth.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Thor and Loki find Odin dying in Norway, and before he fades away he tells his sons he loves them.
stages.whoA: His son, who finds him dying in Norway and hears he is loved.
stages.whoB: His father, who tells him he loves him before he fades away.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Valkyrie was one of Odin's elite Valkyrior, and she lost her sisters when Odin sent them against Hela. After the massacre she abandons Asgard for good.
stages.whoA: One of his elite Valkyrior, who abandons Asgard after the massacre.
stages.whoB: Her king, who sent her sisters to die against Hela.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye and Natasha Romanoff take on Proxima Midnight when she tries to kill Wanda Maximoff during the Battle of Wakanda. Proxima overpowers them both until Wanda throws her into the path of a Thresher.
stages.whoA: A Black Order warrior who overpowers her until Wanda intervenes.
stages.whoB: A general who fights her in the Battle of Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Okoye serves Queen Ramonda as general of the Dora Milaje. When Shuri is captured by the Talokanil on Okoye's watch, Ramonda strips her of her rank.
stages.whoA: Her queen, who strips her rank after Shuri is taken.
stages.whoB: Her general, whom she strips of rank after Shuri is taken.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Okoye and Shuri come to MIT to bring Riri Williams to safety, and Okoye blocks her escape through the bathroom.
stages.whoA: An inventor she brings to safety, blocking her escape.
stages.whoB: A general who helps bring her to safety and blocks her escape.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye guards Shuri, and the two tease T'Challa together like family.
stages.whoA: The princess she guards, and her partner in teasing T'Challa.
stages.whoB: Her guard, and her partner in teasing T'Challa.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: When Shuri is taken by the Talokanil on Okoye's watch, Okoye loses her rank, but she returns to fight beside Shuri as a Midnight Angel in the war against Talokan.
stages.whoA: The princess taken on her watch, whom she later fights beside.
stages.whoB: Her old guard, who loses her rank, then fights beside her as Midnight Angel.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye fights beside Steve Rogers in the Battle of Wakanda.
stages.whoA: Captain America, who fights beside her in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: The Dora Milaje's general, who fights beside him in Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: In the years after the Snap she keeps in touch with Steve's Avengers, and she joins them again in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whose Avengers she keeps in touch with after the Snap.
stages.whoB: An ally who keeps in touch and fights in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye serves King T'Chaka in the Dora Milaje. He trusts her to watch over his son T'Challa on missions, and she carries that loyalty over when T'Challa becomes king.
stages.whoA: Her king, who trusts her to watch over his son.
stages.whoB: One of his Dora Milaje, trusted to watch over his son.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje, the king's guard, and is T'Challa's closest protector. When Killmonger takes the throne she stays loyal to it at first, then joins T'Challa when he returns to win it back.
stages.whoA: Her king and charge. She returns to his side to win back the throne.
stages.whoB: His closest protector and leader of the Dora Milaje.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje in tracking Ulysses Klaue to a casino in Busan, where his vibranium sale turns into a trap. She ambushes his bodyguards and joins the car chase through the city to catch him.
stages.whoA: The arms dealer she tracks to Busan and chases through the city.
stages.whoB: The Dora Milaje's leader, who ambushes his guards in Busan.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi is Okoye's husband. They end up on opposite sides when he backs Killmonger.
stages.whoA: Her husband, who sides with Killmonger against her.
stages.whoB: His wife, who stands against him when he backs Killmonger.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: In the Battle of Wakanda, Wanda saves Okoye and Natasha from the Threshers, and Okoye asks why she held back so long. Okoye and Natasha then step in to save Wanda when Proxima Midnight moves to kill her.
stages.whoA: An Avenger who saves her from the Threshers, and whom she saves in turn.
stages.whoB: A general she saves from the Threshers, who then saves her from Proxima.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Oscar Arocho is Vido's father, raising him after a prison stint for forgery and fighting to keep him when Vido's mother Sonia tries to take him away. Vido's admiration for Jessica, who saves his life, draws Oscar close to her.
stages.whoA: His son, whom he raises and fights to keep.
stages.whoB: His father, who raises him and fights to keep him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Will Simpson is a former colleague of Clemons's on the force, and he kills Clemons while hunting Kilgrave.
stages.whoA: A former colleague on the force, who kills him hunting Kilgrave.
stages.whoB: A former colleague he kills while hunting Kilgrave.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Ouroboros learned TVA science from Victor Timely's writings and idolizes him. Once Timely comes to the TVA, the two work together and grow close.
stages.whoA: His idol, whose writings taught him TVA science, now a close friend.
stages.whoB: A technician who idolizes his writings and becomes a close friend.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon serves in Gravik's rebellion against Talos and tries to kill him.

stages.text: Ray Krzeminski is one of the SSR agents who belittle Peggy Carter, sneering at her ties to Howard Stark and Captain America. Peggy is still shaken when he is murdered, and she suspects a Leviathan-trained woman killed him.
stages.whoA: An SSR agent who belittles her, whose murder shakes her.
stages.whoB: An agent he sneers at over her ties to Stark and Captain America.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley is Peggy Carter's chief at the SSR and mostly keeps her on desk duty. When the evidence points to her helping Howard Stark, he has her interrogated and fires her, but he comes to believe her warning about Ivchenko just before Fennhoff takes over his mind.

stages.whoB: His agent, kept on desk duty, whom he fires and then believes.

stages.text: Rose Roberts mans the front desk of the SSR's New York office and is friendly with Peggy Carter from the start.
stages.whoA: The SSR's front desk receptionist, friendly from the start.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent she is friendly with from the start.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Peggy pushes Daniel Sousa to bring Rose on the Roxxon mission, giving Rose her first field assignment.
stages.whoA: A friend she brings on her first field mission.
stages.whoB: The friend who gets her a first field assignment.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Rufus Hunt is sent to kill Peggy Carter. She and Jarvis capture and interrogate him.
stages.whoA: An assassin sent to kill her, whom she captures and interrogates.
stages.whoB: His target, who captures and interrogates him with Jarvis.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sasha Demidov is a silent Leviathan assassin who murders Peggy Carter's roommate Colleen while hunting for a Nitramene bomb. Peggy fights him twice and finally beats him atop the milk truck carrying Leet Brannis.
stages.whoA: A Leviathan assassin who kills her roommate Colleen.
stages.whoB: An SSR agent who fights him twice and finally beats him.

stages.text: Peggy Carter is Sharon Carter's great-aunt, and Sharon follows her into intelligence work. When Peggy dies, Sharon speaks at her funeral, which is how Steve learns who she is.
stages.whoA: Her great-niece, who follows her into intelligence work.
stages.whoB: Her great-aunt, a spy she follows into intelligence work.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy Carter confronts Spider Raymond at his nightclub about the stolen weapon.
stages.whoA: A nightclub owner she confronts about a stolen weapon.
stages.whoB: An agent who confronts him at his nightclub.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Peggy Carter and Steve Rogers fall in love during the war, but he is lost in the ice before their promised dance.
stages.whoA: The man she loves, lost in the ice before their dance.
stages.whoB: The woman he loves, whose dance he misses when lost in the ice.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Steve finds Peggy alive but frail in the present, and he visits her as her memory fades.
stages.whoA: Her old love, who visits her as her memory fades.
stages.whoB: His old love, alive but frail, whom he visits as her memory fades.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the final battle, Steve travels back in time to finally have that dance and spend his life with her.
stages.whoA: The man who comes back in time to finally spend his life with her.
stages.whoB: The woman he goes back in time to share his life with.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters shuts down Peggy Carter's planned raid on the Arena Club with an executive order and an audit of the SSR. He spends his time in Los Angeles shielding the Council of Nine from her investigation.
stages.whoA: An official who shuts down her raid and shields the Council of Nine.
stages.whoB: An agent whose raid he shuts down to shield the Council of Nine.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter investigates Whitney Frost, the actress and hidden genius who draws power from Zero Matter. Peggy fights to stop her from tearing open a rift to the dark dimension.
stages.whoA: An actress and hidden genius she fights to stop opening a rift.
stages.whoB: The agent who investigates her and fights to stop her rift.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Phil Coulson keeps approaching Pepper Potts to set up a S.H.I.E.L.D. debriefing with Tony, and the two become friendly.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who keeps asking for Tony and becomes a friend.
stages.whoB: Tony's assistant, whom he keeps asking for a debriefing.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Pepper Potts is Tony Stark's devoted assistant, and the two grow closer as he becomes Iron Man.
stages.whoA: Her boss, who grows closer to her as he becomes Iron Man.
stages.whoB: His devoted assistant, who grows closer as he becomes Iron Man.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Tony makes Pepper the head of Stark Industries, and after the battle at the Stark Expo they finally admit their feelings.
stages.whoA: The man she loves, who makes her head of Stark Industries.
stages.whoB: The woman he loves, now head of Stark Industries.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Tony and Pepper marry and raise their daughter Morgan, until Tony gives his life to defeat Thanos.
stages.whoA: Her husband and Morgan's father, who gives his life to defeat Thanos.
stages.whoB: His wife and Morgan's mother.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When the Guardians mistake him for one of Thanos's men on Titan, Peter Quill holds Peter Parker at gunpoint. Once they sort it out, the two fight Thanos side by side.
stages.whoA: A Guardian who holds him at gunpoint, then fights Thanos beside him.
stages.whoB: A kid he mistakes for Thanos's man, then fights beside on Titan.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington teaches Peter at Midtown High and coaches the academic decathlon team, happily welcoming him back for Nationals. Spider-Man saves him and the team from the falling Washington Monument elevator.
stages.whoA: His teacher and decathlon coach, whom he saves at the monument.
stages.whoB: His student and decathlon team member, whom he welcomes back.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker and Sam Wilson first meet as opponents at the airport battle over the Sokovia Accords, where Sam takes him on with missiles and his drone Redwing.
stages.whoA: Falcon, who takes him on with missiles and Redwing at the airport.
stages.whoB: A kid he fights at the airport with missiles and Redwing.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Falcon, on his side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, on his side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker and Scott Lang meet as opponents at the airport battle, where Scott kicks Peter to win back Steve's shield and Peter brings down his giant form with webbing.
stages.whoA: Ant-Man, whose giant form he brings down at the airport.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who brings down his giant form with webbing at the airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Ant-Man, on his side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, on his side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter rescues Stephen Strange from Ebony Maw's ship and fights beside him against Thanos on Titan.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange, whom he rescues from Ebony Maw's ship.
stages.whoB: A kid who rescues him from Ebony Maw and fights beside him on Titan.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Years later, Peter asks Strange to make the world forget he is Spider-Man, and his meddling with the spell breaks open the multiverse.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer he asks to make the world forget, whose spell he breaks.
stages.whoB: A friend whose meddling with his spell breaks open the multiverse.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker first meets Steve Rogers in battle, when Tony Stark brings him to the Leipzig airport and he snatches Steve's shield.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whose shield he snatches at the airport.
stages.whoB: A kid who snatches his shield at the Leipzig airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoA: Captain America, on his side in the Battle of Earth.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, on his side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Parker fights Thanos on Titan and fades away in Tony Stark's arms after the snap.
stages.whoA: The warlord he fights on Titan, whose snap makes him fade away.
stages.whoB: A kid who fights him on Titan and fades away after the snap.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Adrian Toomes, the Vulture, sells stolen alien tech and fights Peter Parker when Peter tries to stop him. He figures out Peter is Spider-Man, Peter saves his life anyway, and Toomes keeps his secret in prison.
stages.whoA: Adrian Toomes, who learns his secret and keeps it in prison.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who stops his tech sales and saves his life.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Tony Stark recruits Peter Parker, gives him his first high-tech Spider-Man suit and becomes his mentor. Peter looks up to him almost like a father.
stages.whoA: His mentor, whom he looks up to almost like a father.
stages.whoB: His protégé, whom he gives his first high-tech suit.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter stows away to fight Thanos at Tony's side on Titan, and he fades away in Tony's arms after the Snap.
stages.whoA: His mentor, in whose arms he fades away after the Snap.
stages.whoB: His protégé, who stows away to Titan and fades in his arms.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later Peter returns to fight beside Tony in the Battle of Earth, and he is with Tony when he dies.
stages.whoA: His mentor. He fights beside Tony again and is with him when he dies.
stages.whoB: His protégé, back to fight beside him, and with him when he dies.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: William Ginter Riva works for Quentin Beck and helps run the drone illusions behind Mysterio. After Beck dies, Riva sends doctored footage to The Daily Bugle that frames Peter Parker for murder and reveals his identity to the world.
stages.whoA: Beck's partner, who frames him and reveals his identity.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom he frames for murder and unmasks to the world.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Yelena, now working as Black Widow, is an ally of Spider-Man, and they have traded numbers. She tells him someone is attacking Damage Control facilities in search of V-Max, and later learns from redacted Damage Control files that Sara is Jean Grey's sister.
stages.whoA: Black Widow, an ally who tips him off about Damage Control attacks.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, an ally she has traded numbers with.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter Quill's Guardians rescue Phyla and the other children from the High Evolutionary's ship.
stages.whoA: One of the children his Guardians rescue.
stages.whoB: The leader of the Guardians who rescue her.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter Quill hunts Theel for the override code that can save Rocket and ends up killing him.
stages.whoA: A Recorder he hunts for Rocket's override code, then kills.
stages.whoB: The Guardian who hunts him for an override code and kills him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rhomann Dey has arrested Quill before and teases him by calling him "Star-Prince." When Quill warns that Ronan is coming for Xandar, Dey vouches for him to the Nova Corps.
stages.whoA: A Nova officer who calls him Star-Prince and vouches for him.
stages.whoB: A thief he has arrested, teases, and vouches for.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Groot first try to collect the bounty on Peter Quill, and the three end up founding the Guardians of the Galaxy together. Quill and Rocket bicker constantly but become close friends.
stages.whoA: A bounty hunter turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.
stages.whoB: A bounty turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leads the Guardians' desperate mission to save Rocket's life, and afterward he hands Rocket leadership of the team before going home to Earth.
stages.whoA: His close friend, whose life he fights to save, then hands the team.
stages.whoB: His close friend, who saves his life and hands him the team.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Peter Quill distracts Ronan with a dance-off, and the Guardians then use the Power Stone to destroy him.
stages.whoA: The Kree warlord he distracts with a dance-off before he is destroyed.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who distracts him with a dance-off.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: On Titan, Quill and Stephen Strange first face off, each thinking the other works for Thanos, then join forces to ambush him.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange, first a suspect, then an ally against Thanos.
stages.whoB: A Guardian he first suspects, then joins to ambush Thanos.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Taserface serves in Yondu's Ravager crew while Peter grows up there, and resents how Yondu keeps protecting Peter even after he betrays the clan. That grudge fuels Taserface's mutiny, and he orders the Ravagers to hunt down and kill the Guardians.
stages.whoA: A Ravager who resents Yondu protecting him, and hunts the Guardians.
stages.whoB: Yondu's favorite, whom he resents and orders killed.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill attacks Thanos on Titan after learning he killed Gamora, which ruins the plan to take the Gauntlet. Quill is later wiped out by the snap.
stages.whoA: The Titan who killed Gamora, whom he attacks in rage.
stages.whoB: A Guardian whose rage ruins the plan to take the Gauntlet.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: The Sovereign hire Peter Quill and the Guardians to stop the Abilisk, a giant space monster feeding on their batteries, and they kill it.
stages.whoA: A space monster he and the Guardians kill for the Sovereign.
stages.whoB: One of the Guardians hired to stop it, who kill it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: The Collector offers four billion units for the Orb, and Peter Quill and his crew bring it to him on Knowhere. The deal falls apart when his servant Carina grabs the Infinity Stone inside and it destroys much of his museum.
stages.whoA: A collector who offers four billion units for the Orb.
stages.whoB: A seller who brings him the Orb on Knowhere.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leads the Guardians against the High Evolutionary to save Rocket's life. Confronting him at his base, Quill calls out the flaws in his Counter-Earth, and the Guardians go on to defeat him.
stages.whoA: The scientist he leads the Guardians against to save Rocket.
stages.whoB: The Guardian who calls out his Counter-Earth's flaws and defeats him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill feels threatened when the Guardians pick Thor up in space and starts deepening his voice to compete.
stages.whoA: The god whose arrival makes him feel threatened.
stages.whoB: A Guardian who deepens his voice to compete with him.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: After the war with Thanos, Thor travels with the Guardians, and the two part as friends.
stages.whoA: A friend who travels with the Guardians, then parts on good terms.
stages.whoB: A friend he travels with after the war with Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill and Tony Stark meet in a standoff on Titan before realizing they are both fighting Thanos. Their plan to pull off the Infinity Gauntlet falls apart when Quill learns Gamora's fate and attacks Thanos in a rage.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, an ally on Titan after a standoff.
stages.whoB: A Guardian whose rage wrecks their plan to take the Gauntlet.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Yondu Udonta takes Peter Quill from Earth as a boy and raises him as a Ravager. When the grown Quill cuts him out of the deal for the Orb, Yondu hunts him across the galaxy, then lets him go after the battle of Xandar.
stages.whoA: The Ravager who takes him from Earth and raises him.
stages.whoB: The boy he takes from Earth and raises as a Ravager.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Yondu reveals he kept young Peter from his father Ego, and he gives his life to save Peter, who finally sees him as his real father.
stages.whoA: His real father, who kept him from Ego and dies saving him.
stages.whoB: The son he kept from Ego and gives his life to save.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sersi and Ikaris visit Phastos at his home in Chicago and convince him to rejoin the Eternals.
stages.whoA: A fellow Eternal who convinces him to rejoin the team.
stages.whoB: A fellow Eternal she convinces to rejoin.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Piper joins Phil Coulson's task force to take out Hive, telling him her gun's safety was never on.
stages.whoA: An agent on his task force against Hive.
stages.whoB: Her director, whose task force she joins to take out Hive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Years later she lures his team into General Hale's trap at a Kree beacon. When Coulson tells her to pick a side, she turns back to S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: A former agent who lures his team into Hale's trap, then turns back.
stages.whoB: Her old director, who tells her to pick a side.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina has Centipede kidnap Phil Coulson and puts him in a memory machine to dig out the secret of his return from the dead, until Skye rescues him.
stages.whoA: The Centipede agent who kidnaps him and digs into his memories.
stages.whoB: The agent she kidnaps to dig out the secret of his return.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina tries to blackmail Coulson into helping her get the Diviner.
stages.whoA: A blackmailer trying to get the Diviner through him.
stages.whoB: The director she tries to blackmail over the Diviner.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Phil Coulson first tracks Robbie Reyes, the new Ghost Rider, as a dangerous killer, but learns he lives by a code. They team up against Eli Morrow and Aida, and Coulson even makes his own deal with the Spirit of Vengeance to stop Aida.
stages.whoA: Ghost Rider, a killer with a code who becomes his ally.
stages.whoB: The director who hunts him, then teams up against Aida.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales leads the rival S.H.I.E.L.D. that seizes Coulson's base and demands his Toolbox of secrets. Once Coulson proves himself, they agree to merge their factions, and Gonzales is killed soon after while trying to make peace with the Inhumans.
stages.whoA: The rival director who seizes his base, then merges with him.
stages.whoB: The rival director whose Toolbox he demands, then merges with.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Rosalind Price leads the ATCU, and she and Phil Coulson start a romance. Grant Ward kills her, which drives Coulson to revenge.
stages.whoA: The ATCU's head and his love, whom Ward kills.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director she falls for, who avenges her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale helps capture Phil Coulson for her mother and does her best to get under his skin, but nothing she does rattles him.
stages.whoA: Hale's daughter, who helps capture him and tries to rattle him.
stages.whoB: The captive she tries and fails to rattle.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson picked Sebastian Derik as one of the test subjects for Project T.A.H.I.T.I., and the alien treatment drives Derik to kill the others. When Coulson comes to stop him, Derik ties him up, and they fight before Coulson's team arrives.
stages.whoA: A T.A.H.I.T.I. subject he picked, driven to kill by the treatment.
stages.whoB: The man who picked him for T.A.H.I.T.I., whom he ties up.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Phil Coulson shoots Sinara in the shoulder just as she is about to take Daisy Johnson into custody on the Lighthouse.
stages.whoA: A Kree enforcer he shoots to stop her taking Daisy.
stages.whoB: The man who shoots her before she can take Daisy.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Phil Coulson idolizes Captain America and collects his vintage trading cards, and he is the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who helps bring Steve Rogers onto the Avengers. Loki kills Coulson before Steve can sign the cards, and his death helps unite the team.
stages.whoA: His idol, whose trading cards he never gets signed.
stages.whoB: His biggest fan, whose death helps unite the team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi and Agent 33 move against Phil Coulson's team over a painting carved with alien writing. Coulson chases Bakshi down, knocks him out and takes the painting, and later hands him over to Glenn Talbot.
stages.whoA: A Hydra agent he knocks out and hands to Talbot.
stages.whoB: The director who knocks him out and hands him to Talbot.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Years ago in Russia, Phil Coulson and Melinda May slip away from Anton Ivanov's unit with an 0-8-4, and Ivanov's comrades are executed for the failure. Now calling himself the Superior, he blames Coulson and hunts him.
stages.whoA: Anton Ivanov, who blames him for his comrades' execution.
stages.whoB: The agent whose theft of an 0-8-4 got his comrades executed.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Phil Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. team seizes the crater around Mjolnir and catches Thor when he breaks in to reclaim it. Thor comes to respect him.
stages.whoA: The god he catches breaking in to reclaim Mjolnir.
stages.whoB: The agent who catches him at Mjolnir and earns his respect.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Coulson stands up to Loki on the Helicarrier, and his death there hits Thor hard.
stages.whoA: An ally hit hard by his death on the Helicarrier.
stages.whoB: An agent whose death on the Helicarrier hits him hard.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Phil Coulson is the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who keeps trying to debrief Tony Stark after his escape from Afghanistan.
stages.whoA: The man he keeps trying to debrief.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who keeps trying to debrief him.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Coulson keeps an eye on Tony for Nick Fury, and Tony slowly warms to him.
stages.whoA: His assignment for Fury, who slowly warms to him.
stages.whoB: Fury's agent, watching him, whom he slowly warms to.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Coulson's death on the Helicarrier pushes Tony to fight Loki as an Avenger.
stages.whoA: A friend whom his death pushes to fight Loki.
stages.whoB: A friend whose death pushes him to fight Loki.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand clashes with Phil Coulson over sending his people into South Ossetia without telling them there is no extraction, and she later suspects his team of serving Hydra. Once she sees they are loyal, she works with him to retake the Hub.
stages.whoA: A commander who doubts him, then helps him retake the Hub.
stages.whoB: An agent she suspects of Hydra, then works with to retake the Hub.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson's team captures Vin-Tak, and Coulson questions him with Sif on the Bus. The Kree restores Sif's memory and explains the Diviners, then turns on Skye as soon as he learns she is Inhuman.
stages.whoA: A Kree captive he questions, who turns on Skye.
stages.whoB: The director who captures and questions him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Phil Coulson captures Werner von Strucker and interrogates him to find Gideon Malick, driven by revenge for Rosalind Price's murder. Broken by his ordeal, Werner begs Coulson to just kill him.
stages.whoA: Hydra's heir, whom he interrogates for Malick to avenge Rosalind.
stages.whoB: The man who interrogates him until he begs to die.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Phineas Mason is Adrian Toomes's engineer, and he builds the crew's alien-tech weapons.
stages.whoA: His boss, for whom he builds alien-tech weapons.
stages.whoB: His engineer, who builds the crew's alien-tech weapons.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Rocket rescues Phyla from the High Evolutionary's ship and later leads her in the new Guardians of the Galaxy.
stages.whoA: Her rescuer and leader on the new Guardians.
stages.whoB: A girl he rescues and leads on the new Guardians.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary experiments on Phyla, one of the Star Children he holds on his ship.
stages.whoA: Her captor, who experiments on her.
stages.whoB: One of the Star Children he experiments on.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro Maximoff fights the Avengers on Ultron's side until he and his sister turn against the robot. He then fights under Steve Rogers in the Battle of Sokovia, where he is killed.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whom he fights under in Sokovia, where he dies.
stages.whoB: A former enemy who fights under him in Sokovia and is killed.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tommy is the nephew of Pietro Maximoff, Wanda's speedster twin, and shares his super speed.
stages.whoA: His nephew, Wanda's son, who shares his speed.
stages.whoB: His uncle, his mother's speedster twin.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro Maximoff hates Tony Stark for the Stark shell that killed his parents and joins Ultron against him. He switches sides and fights with Tony's Avengers in the Battle of Sokovia, where he dies.
stages.whoA: The man whose shell killed his parents, later his ally in Sokovia.
stages.whoB: A sworn enemy over his parents' deaths, who later dies on his side.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro and Wanda join Ultron to take revenge on Tony Stark, then abandon him once they learn he wants to wipe out humanity. In Sokovia, Pietro is killed by gunfire from Ultron's jet while shielding Clint Barton and a child.
stages.whoA: The robot he joins for revenge, then turns on. Ultron's jet kills him.
stages.whoB: A recruit who turns on him, then dies under his jet's gunfire.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Pietro Maximoff is Wanda's twin brother, and the two are held in Hydra's labs as Baron Strucker's test subjects.
stages.whoA: His twin sister, held with him in Hydra's labs.
stages.whoB: Her twin brother, held with her in Hydra's labs.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro fights at Wanda's side, first for Ultron and then with the Avengers. He dies in Sokovia saving Clint Barton, leaving Wanda alone.
stages.whoA: His twin sister, whom he fights beside until he dies in Sokovia.
stages.whoB: Her twin brother, who dies in Sokovia saving Clint and leaves her alone.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale counts on Piper to lure S.H.I.E.L.D. to the Kree beacon, then attacks everyone there with her robot soldiers. Seeing Ruby's betrayal, Piper switches sides and helps the agents escape.
stages.whoA: Hale's daughter, whose betrayal turns her back to S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: An agent she uses as bait, who switches sides when betrayed.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Tone, acting on Turk Barrett's tip, opens fire on Pop's barbershop to get Chico Diaz and kills Pop instead. Furious at losing Pop, Cottonmouth throws Tone off a roof.
stages.whoA: The gunman who shoots up his barbershop and kills him.
stages.whoB: The barber he kills shooting up the shop for Chico.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett spends his days playing chess in Pop's barbershop, and when he learns Pop is sheltering Chico Diaz, he tips off Cottonmouth's men. That tip leads to the shooting that kills Pop.
stages.whoA: A regular at his chess table whose tip gets him killed.
stages.whoB: The barber he plays chess with, killed after Turk's tip.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tom Ridenhour takes over Priscilla Ridley's precinct when she is promoted to deputy chief. After he is killed, Ridley returns to lead it and sees his murder answered when she arrests Mariah Dillard.
stages.whoA: Her successor at the precinct, whose murder she answers.
stages.whoB: His predecessor at the precinct, who returns after his murder.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Sam Wilson flies into the fight in Edinburgh and kicks Proxima Midnight through a café's security gate to save Wanda and Vision. He faces her army again in Wakanda, where he helps destroy one of the giant war machines she sends.
stages.whoA: Falcon, who kicks her through a gate in Edinburgh.
stages.whoB: A Black Order warrior he kicks through a gate to save Wanda and Vision.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight is about to rip the Mind Stone from Vision in Edinburgh when Steve Rogers arrives with Sam Wilson and Natasha Romanoff. Steve fights her off and drives the Black Order away, and he faces her again in Wakanda when she demands Vision's surrender.
stages.whoA: Captain America, who drives her off Vision in Edinburgh.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Xialing breaks Trevor out of Wenwu's cell along with Shang-Chi and Katy, and they escape in Razor Fist's car to Ta Lo.
stages.whoA: The sister who breaks him out of Wenwu's cell.
stages.whoB: A prisoner she breaks out with Shang-Chi and Katy.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Will Simpson tries to kill Trish while under Kilgrave's control. Afterward they start a romance that ends when he becomes violent.
stages.whoA: A cop who tries to kill her under Kilgrave's control, then her lover.
stages.whoB: The woman he tried to kill, then dates until he turns violent.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett does business with Vladimir's Russian mob before they turn on each other.
stages.whoA: A Russian mob boss he deals with until they turn on each other.
stages.whoB: An arms dealer he deals with until they turn on each other.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett runs jobs for Fisk's organization, including a human trafficking shipment. He is arrested when Fisk's operation is exposed.
stages.whoA: The boss whose jobs he runs, until the operation is exposed.
stages.whoB: A crook who runs jobs for his organization.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Tyesha Hillman marries Yusuf's son Aamir, making her Yusuf's daughter-in-law.
stages.whoA: Her father-in-law, Aamir's father.
stages.whoB: His daughter-in-law, married to his son Aamir.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward takes Vision's body after his death, refuses to let Wanda bury him, and spends years trying to rebuild him as a S.W.O.R.D. weapon. Using energy from Westview, he finally brings him back as the White Vision and sends him to destroy Wanda's Vision.
stages.whoA: The dead Avenger he rebuilds as the White Vision.
stages.whoB: The man who takes his body and rebuilds him as a weapon.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward treats Wanda Maximoff as a threat. He fires a missile at her and builds the White Vision to use against her.
stages.whoA: A threat he fires a missile at and builds a weapon against.
stages.whoB: The S.W.O.R.D. director who fires a missile at her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron buys Ulysses Klaue's entire stock of vibranium for his plan. When Klaue compares him to Tony Stark, Ultron flies into a rage and cuts off his arm.
stages.whoA: The arms dealer whose vibranium he buys, then whose arm he cuts off.
stages.whoB: A buyer for his vibranium, who cuts off his arm in a rage.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Vision is created from the body Ultron built for himself, and he destroys Ultron's last body.
stages.whoA: The being made from his body, who destroys his last one.
stages.whoB: The robot whose body he is made from, and whom he destroys.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda and Pietro join Ultron to take revenge on Tony Stark. When Wanda sees that he plans to wipe out humanity, she turns on him, and after he kills Pietro she rips out his core.
stages.whoA: A recruit who turns on him and rips out his core.
stages.whoB: The robot she joins, then turns on after he kills Pietro.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi's parents die in Ulysses Klaue's 1992 raid on Wakanda, and he spends years wanting the man caught. When Erik Killmonger arrives with Klaue's body, W'Kabi throws his support behind Erik.
stages.whoA: A Wakandan whose parents die in his raid.
stages.whoB: The man who killed his parents in the 1992 raid.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda Maximoff and her brother storm Ulysses Klaue's salvage yard ahead of Ultron's vibranium deal. Klaue mocks them for their youth, taunts them about Strucker's death and tells Wanda that anyone who fiddles with his brain is not the one in charge.
stages.whoA: A young enhanced he taunts at his salvage yard.
stages.whoB: The arms dealer who mocks her at his salvage yard.

stages.title: Black Widow (Post-Credits Scene)
stages.text: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine recruits Yelena Belova after Natasha's death and sends her after Clint Barton, the man she blames.
stages.whoA: Her new recruit, sent after Clint Barton.
stages.whoB: Her new boss, who sends her after Clint Barton.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Yelena keeps doing Valentina's dirty work until Valentina tries to have her killed to cover up her own crimes.
stages.whoA: Her operative, whom she tries to have killed.
stages.whoB: Her boss, who tries to have her killed.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Valkyrie fights her way out of Zeus's palace and takes his Thunderbolt as her weapon.
stages.whoA: The god whose Thunderbolt she takes.
stages.whoB: A warrior who fights out of his palace with his Thunderbolt.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk falls in love with art dealer Vanessa Marianna, and she stands by him even after learning what he is.
stages.whoA: The man she loves and stands by after learning what he is.
stages.whoB: The art dealer he loves, who stands by him.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk marries Vanessa after his release, and she becomes his partner in both life and crime.
stages.whoA: Her husband and partner in life and crime.
stages.whoB: His wife and partner in life and crime.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters serves the Council of Nine and takes his orders from Whitney Frost once she seizes control of it. He breaks with her by striking a deal with Jack Thompson, Peggy Carter and Daniel Sousa.
stages.whoA: The Council's new leader, whom he serves, then crosses.
stages.whoB: A Council man who takes her orders, then cuts a deal against her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Vision is born in the fight against Ultron and carries Wanda to safety as Sokovia falls.
stages.whoA: A new ally he carries to safety as Sokovia falls.
stages.whoB: A new being who carries her to safety as Sokovia falls.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision and Wanda grow close at the Avengers Compound, though he keeps her there under the Sokovia Accords.
stages.whoA: A close friend he keeps at the compound under the Accords.
stages.whoB: A close friend, though he keeps her at the compound.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Vision and Wanda fall in love. She is forced to destroy him to keep the Mind Stone from Thanos.
stages.whoA: The woman he loves, who must destroy him to stop Thanos.
stages.whoB: The man she loves, whom she must destroy to stop Thanos.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Wanda's grief gives rise to Westview, where she conjures a new Vision and a life with him.
stages.whoA: His love, whose grief conjures him and their life in Westview.
stages.whoB: The love she conjures anew in Westview.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Vladimir Ranskahov partners with Fisk until Fisk murders his brother Anatoly. Vladimir then turns on Fisk and dies fighting his men.
stages.whoA: His former partner, who murders his brother Anatoly.
stages.whoB: A former partner who turns on him after Anatoly's murder.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wanda lays siege to Kamar-Taj while hunting America Chavez and knocks Wong aside. She captures him and forces him to lead her to Mount Wundagore, where he reveals the Darkhold's origins to spare the other sorcerers.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer she captures to lead her to Mount Wundagore.
stages.whoB: The witch who captures him and forces him to Mount Wundagore.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wenwu is Xialing's father. He ignores her as a child, and she takes over the Ten Rings after his death.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whom he ignores, who takes over the Ten Rings.
stages.whoB: Her father, who ignores her, and whose Ten Rings she takes over.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wenwu is Ying Nan's brother-in-law. She fights him and his army when he attacks Ta Lo to open the Dark Gate.
stages.whoA: His sister-in-law, who fights him at Ta Lo.
stages.whoB: Her brother-in-law, whom she fights when he attacks Ta Lo.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Zane is one of Fisk's men in Oklahoma. Fisk orders him to stand down just before he executes Maya Lopez and her uncle.
stages.whoA: One of his men in Oklahoma, ordered to stand down before executing Maya.
stages.whoB: His boss, who stops him just before he executes Maya.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Ying Nan is Xialing's aunt, her mother's sister, and welcomes her to Ta Lo.
stages.whoA: Her aunt, her mother's sister, who welcomes her to Ta Lo.
stages.whoB: Her niece, her sister's daughter, whom she welcomes to Ta Lo.
